TEXLINE: sections/signatures.tex:13-41 structure Instance where
  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Row margins `r_i`. -/
  r : Fin m → ℕ
  /-- Column margins `c_j`. -/
  c : Fin n → ℕ
  /-- Cell upper bounds `b_ij`; zero is allowed. -/
  b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def smallB (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ := (smallAt I ε δ s).2.2

/-- The small cell of each pair label: cell `s` owns `b_s` consecutive labels. -/
noncomputable def pSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((smallCells I ε δ).map fun e => e.2.2).sum

/-- Large cells by decreasing bound, ties in retained order: each cell is
inserted before the first one of strictly smaller bound. -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def smallAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry :=
  (smallCells I ε δ).getD k (0, 0, 0)

/-- The `k`-th free cell. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/
abbrev rate : Rate Op := Rate.unit Op

/-- INTERNAL: charge `k` bit operations and return `a`.  Private, so it is not a
primitive a program can call; every public wrapper below fixes its own `k`. -/
private def bits {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell α :=
  Charged.opMany Op.bit k a

/-! ## Sealed naturals -/

/-- **A sealed natural number.**  Built only by the charged primitives of this
file, read only through them. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
inductive Op where
  /-- One bit operation. -/
  | bit
  /-- One randomness operation; the program performs only `RandOp.flip`. -/
  | rand (o : RandOp)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Every operation, as a list. -/
def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.size k + 1

/-- Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its
numerator and of its denominator. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × ℕ

/-- The retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive bound, in row-major
order.  Cells with `b_s = 0` are deleted; all vertices are retained. -/
noncomputable def WParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 100 * dParam I * BParam I ε δ

/-- `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def cellRange (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  cellHigh I i j - cellLow I i j

/-- A cell of the tightened table: row, column, bound. -/
noncomputable def margin (I : Instance) (v : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if v < I.m then (tRow I v : ℚ) else (tCol I (v - I.m) : ℚ)

/-- The load of vertex `v` from the non-tree cells: a small cell adds `x_s` to
its row and `b_s - y_s` to its column (R1); a free cell adds `z_e` to both
endpoints. -/
def Op.all : List Op :=
  [.bit, .rand .flip, .rand .accept, .rand .halve, .rand .inflate]

/-- The currency is finite, so `CostVec.steps` can sum over it. -/
instance : Fintype Op :=
  Fintype.ofList Op.all (by intro o; cases o with
    | bit => decide
    | rand r => cases r <;> decide)

/-- The randomness operations, filed under `Op.rand`. -/
noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ := I.m * I.n + I.m + I.n + 2

/-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. -/
noncomputable def BParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 16 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2

/-- `W = 100 d B`. -/
noncomputable def cellHigh (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  if h : I.Omega.Nonempty then (I.Omega.image fun X => X i j).max' (h.image _) else 0

/-- The tightened bound `b_s = u_s - l_s`. -/
noncomputable def cellLow (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  if h : I.Omega.Nonempty then (I.Omega.image fun X => X i j).min' (h.image _) else 0

/-- `u_ij`, the greatest value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω`. -/
noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/
def inputLength (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  bitLen I.m + bitLen I.n + ∑ i, bitLen (I.r i) + ∑ j, bitLen (I.c j)
    + ∑ i, ∑ j, bitLen (I.b i j) + ratLen ε + ratLen δ

/-! ## The quantity -/

/-- **`Ω(r,c,b)`** (`eq:feasible-set`): the nonnegative integer matrices with
row sums `r`, column sums `c`, and `X i j ≤ b i j` for every cell. -/
noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈(4 * KParam I ε δ : ℚ) / γParam I ε δ⌉₊

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
def eq (x y : SNat) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen x.raw + bitLen y.raw) (decide (x.raw = y.raw))

/-- The encoded length `bitLen x = Nat.size x + 1` of `Model/Prelude.lean`. -/
def ratLen (q : ℚ) : ℕ := bitLen q.num.natAbs + bitLen q.den

/-- **The input length `L`** of `(m, n, r, c, b, ε, δ)`: the sum of the binary
lengths of `m`, `n`, every margin, every cell bound (including zero bounds),
and the two accuracy parameters. -/
def set {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell (List α) :=
  bits (i + 1) (l.set i a)

/-- Append one entry, at the price of walking the list. -/
noncomputable def KParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  20 * (inputLength I ε δ + dParam I + Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊ + 1)

/-- `γ = ε / (512 d K)`. -/
noncomputable def γParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ε / (512 * dParam I * KParam I ε δ)

/-- `A = ⌈4K/γ⌉`. -/
def bitLen (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw⟩

/-- The bit size `Nat.size x`, so that `Nat.clog 2 x = Nat.size (x - 1)`. -/

  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Row margins `r_i`. -/
  r : Fin m → ℕ
  /-- Column margins `c_j`. -/
  c : Fin n → ℕ
  /-- Cell upper bounds `b_ij`; zero is allowed. -/
  b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
noncomputable def refMu0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF (Finset ℕ) :=
  loop (fun s S => do
    let k ← uniformBelow (smallB I ε δ s + 1)
    let rank ← uniformBelow (Nat.choose (smallB I ε δ s) k)
    pure (S ∪ (Finset.range (smallB I ε δ s)).image fun t =>
      if t ∈ unrank (smallB I ε δ s) k rank then 2 * (cellFirst I ε δ s + t)
      else 2 * (cellFirst I ε δ s + t) + 1))
    (nSmall I ε δ) ∅

/-- INTERNAL: one iteration of the capped reference restart, `restartStep` with
the exact transition.
TEXLINE: sections/algorithm.tex:214-225 -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
noncomputable def loop {β : Type} (f : ℕ → β → PMF β) (k : ℕ) (b : β) : PMF β :=
  (List.range k).foldlM (fun b i => f i b) b

/-- `k` fair bits read as a binary integer: uniform on `[0, 2^k)`. -/
noncomputable def uniformBelow (k : ℕ) : PMF ℕ :=
  if h : 0 < k then PMF.uniformOfFinset (Finset.range k) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.2 h⟩
  else PMF.pure 0

/-- **`f_j(S)`** (`eq:lifts`): `h_j(x, y) ∏_s x_s! y_s! / b_s!` at the
small-count profile of `S`.
PAPER: sections/signatures.tex:22-31 -/
noncomputable def smallB (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ := (smallAt I ε δ s).2.2

/-- The small cell of each pair label: cell `s` owns `b_s` consecutive labels. -/
noncomputable def unrank (b k r : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  ((List.range b).foldl (fun st t =>
    if 0 < st.2.1 then
      if st.2.2 < Nat.choose (b - (t + 1)) (st.2.1 - 1) then (insert t st.1, st.2.1 - 1, st.2.2)
      else (st.1, st.2.1, st.2.2 - Nat.choose (b - (t + 1)) (st.2.1 - 1))
    else st) ((∅ : Finset ℕ), k, r)).1

/-- **A fresh `μ₀` draw** (`algorithm.tex:215-224`): per small cell `s`, `k_s` by a
dyadic draw from `{0..b_s}`, then a `k_s`-subset of its `b_s` pairs by a dyadic
draw of a rank in `[0, C(b_s, k_s))`; those pairs use their row element, the rest
their column element. -/
noncomputable def cellFirst (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range s, smallB I ε δ t

/-- `q = W²`. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def restartStep (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (st : Restart) : PMF Restart :=
  if st.finished then pure st else if st.aborted then pure st else
  if BretParam I ε δ ≤ st.used then pure { st with aborted := true } else do
    let S' ← step I ε δ st.stage (ws st.stage) st.S
    match kind I ε δ S' with
    | .transversal =>
      if st.hits + 1 = τParam I ε δ then
        pure ⟨S', st.stage + 1, 0, st.used + 1, decide (st.stage = j), false⟩
      else pure ⟨S', st.stage, st.hits + 1, st.used + 1, false, false⟩
    | _ => pure ⟨S', st.stage, st.hits, st.used + 1, false, false⟩

/-- **S9a**: from `S0`, for `a = 1..j`, `τ` trace steps of `P_{a, w^(a)}`, at most
`B_ret` transitions in all.  `j = 0` returns `S0`. -/
abbrev rate : Rate Op := Rate.unit Op

/-- INTERNAL: charge `k` bit operations and return `a`.  Private, so it is not a
primitive a program can call; every public wrapper below fixes its own `k`. -/
private def bits {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell α :=
  Charged.opMany Op.bit k a

/-! ## Sealed naturals -/

/-- **A sealed natural number.**  Built only by the charged primitives of this
file, read only through them. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
inductive Op where
  /-- One bit operation. -/
  | bit
  /-- One randomness operation; the program performs only `RandOp.flip`. -/
  | rand (o : RandOp)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Every operation, as a list. -/
def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.size k + 1

/-- Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its
numerator and of its denominator. -/
def eq (x y : SNat) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen x.raw + bitLen y.raw) (decide (x.raw = y.raw))

/-- The encoded length `bitLen x = Nat.size x + 1` of `Model/Prelude.lean`. -/
noncomputable def smallAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry :=
  (smallCells I ε δ).getD k (0, 0, 0)

/-- The `k`-th free cell. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
structure Restart where
  /-- Current state. -/
  S : Finset ℕ
  /-- Current stage `a ∈ 1..j`. -/
  stage : ℕ
  /-- Trace steps completed in this stage. -/
  hits : ℕ
  /-- Underlying transitions taken (the cap counter). -/
  used : ℕ
  /-- All stages done. -/
  finished : Bool
  /-- Another transition was needed after the cap. -/
  aborted : Bool

/-- One iteration of the capped restart of phase `j`: stop if finished or
aborted; abort if `B_ret` transitions are used; otherwise one transition of
`P_{a, w^(a)}`, and a trace step ends at a transversal. -/
noncomputable def BretParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  2000 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 2 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) ^ 2 * τParam I ε δ

/-- `N_av = ⌈10⁸ p⁸ K_obs (H + 1) / η²⌉`. -/
noncomputable def step (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (a : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    PMF (Finset ℕ) := do
  let hold ← ProbRAM.fair
  if hold then pure S else do
    let u1 ← dyadicDraw (pSmall I ε δ) (ξParam I ε δ)
    let u2 ← dyadicDraw (pSmall I ε δ) (ξParam I ε δ)
    let S' := insert (nthWith I ε δ S false u2) (S.erase (nthWith I ε δ S true u1))
    match kind I ε δ S' with
    | .outside => pure S
    | k' => do
      let lNew ← lam I ε δ S' k' a w
      let lOld ← lam I ε δ S (kind I ε δ S) a w
      let ok ← acceptTest I ε δ (min 1 (lNew / lOld))
      pure (if ok then S' else S)

/-! ## S9a: the fresh `μ₀` draw and the capped restart -/

/-- Lexicographic unranking: the `r`-th `k`-subset of `[0, b)`, built greedily
(include `t` iff `r < C(b - t - 1, k' - 1)` for the `k'` still to choose). -/
noncomputable def kind (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (S : Finset ℕ) : Program.Kind :=
  let E := (Finset.range (pSmall I ε δ)).filter fun i => 2 * i ∉ S ∧ 2 * i + 1 ∉ S
  let F := (Finset.range (pSmall I ε δ)).filter fun i => 2 * i ∈ S ∧ 2 * i + 1 ∈ S
  if E.card = 0 then (if F.card = 0 then .transversal else .outside)
  else if E.card = 1 ∧ F.card = 1 then .defect (E.sup id) (F.sup id) else .outside

/-- The implemented `λ(S)` at level `a`: a fresh oracle value `ĥ_a(x, y)` (with
`ξ_in = θ = ξ`), times `∏_s x_s! y_s! / b_s!` (`eq:lifts`), times `w_il` on
`A_il`. -/
noncomputable def τParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  2 * KobsParam I ε δ * (HParam I ε δ + pSmall I ε δ + KParam I ε δ + 5)

/-- `B_ret = 2000 p² (H + 1)² τ`. -/
def bitLen (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw⟩

/-- The bit size `Nat.size x`, so that `Nat.clog 2 x = Nat.size (x - 1)`. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × ℕ

/-- The retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive bound, in row-major
order.  Cells with `b_s = 0` are deleted; all vertices are retained. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def WParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 100 * dParam I * BParam I ε δ

/-- `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def restart (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (S0 : Finset ℕ) : PMF Restart :=
  loop (fun _ st => restartStep I ε δ ws j st) (BretParam I ε δ + 1)
    ⟨S0, 1, 0, 0, decide (j = 0), false⟩

/-- The observation tallies: the current state, `n_

structure Instance where
  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Row margins `r_i`. -/
  r : Fin m → ℕ
  /-- Column margins `c_j`. -/
  c : Fin n → ℕ
  /-- Cell upper bounds `b_ij`; zero is allowed. -/
  b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
noncomputable def pSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((smallCells I ε δ).map fun e => e.2.2).sum

/-- Large cells by decreasing bound, ties in retained order: each cell is
inserted before the first one of strictly smaller bound. -/
noncomputable def refRun (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF ℝ :=
  (loop (refPhase I ε δ) (HParam I ε δ)
      ⟨fun a => if a = 0 then w0 I ε δ else fun _ _ => 0, 1, false⟩).map
    fun st => if st.aborted then 0 else (C0 I ε δ : ℝ) * st.prod

/-- INTERNAL: the paired state space: all subsets of the `2p` elements.
TEXLINE: sections/signatures.tex:13-41 -/
noncomputable def HParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  10 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2 * (WParam I ε δ + 1)

/-! ## S4: small and large cells, the maximum spanning forest -/

/-- Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def ξParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ηParam I ε δ / ((1000 * JstarParam I ε δ : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-- `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`, the bits of one acceptance threshold. -/
noncomputable def JstarParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  100 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) *
    (BretParam I ε δ + NavParam I ε δ + pSmall I ε δ + dParam I + 1)

/-- `ξ = η / (1000 J_*)`. -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def loop {β : Type} (f : ℕ → β → PMF β) (k : ℕ) (b : β) : PMF β :=
  (List.range k).foldlM (fun b i => f i b) b

/-- `k` fair bits read as a binary integer: uniform on `[0, 2^k)`. -/
noncomputable def refPhase (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (st : RefRunState) :
    PMF RefRunState :=
  if st.aborted then pure st else do
    let S0 ← refMu0 I ε δ
    let rs ← refRestart I ε δ st.ws j S0
    if rs.aborted then pure { st with aborted := true } else do
      let o ← refObserve I ε δ j (st.ws j) rs.S
      if 0 < o.n0 ∧ ∀ i < pSmall I ε δ, ∀ l < pSmall I ε δ, i ≠ l → 0 < o.nT i l then
        let R := (o.sumG / (NavParam I ε δ : ℝ)) / ((o.n0 : ℝ) / (NavParam I ε δ : ℝ))
        if j + 1 < HParam I ε δ then
          pure ⟨Function.update st.ws (j + 1) (refUpdateW (pSmall I ε δ) (st.ws j) o),
            st.prod * R, false⟩
        else pure ⟨st.ws, st.prod * R, false⟩
      else pure { st with aborted := true }

/-- **The reference experiment** (`algorithm.tex:251-257`): phases `j = 0..H-1`
from `w^(0)`; output `Z_ref = C(0) ∏_j R̂_j`, or `0` after an abort.
PAPER: sections/algorithm.tex:251-257 -/
noncomputable def w0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ := fun i l =>
  if i < pSmall I ε δ ∧ l < pSmall I ε δ ∧ i ≠ l then
    if pairCell I ε δ i = pairCell I ε δ l then 6
    else 6 * ((smallB I ε δ (pairCell I ε δ i) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) /
      ((smallB I ε δ (pairCell I ε δ l) + 2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
  else 0

/-- `C(0) = M_f ∏_{s small} (b_s + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def C0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ((Mf I ε δ * ∏ s ∈ Finset.range (nSmall I ε δ), (smallB I ε δ s + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-! ## The paired state space (`signatures.tex:13-41`) -/

/-- The small-count profile `(x_s, y_s)` of a state `S ⊆ [0, 2p)`: row and column
elements present in small cell `s`. -/
def Op.all : List Op :=
  [.bit, .rand .flip, .rand .accept, .rand .halve, .rand .inflate]

/-- The currency is finite, so `CostVec.steps` can sum over it. -/
instance : Fintype Op :=
  Fintype.ofList Op.all (by intro o; cases o with
    | bit => decide
    | rand r => cases r <;> decide)

/-- The randomness operations, filed under `Op.rand`. -/
noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈(4 * KParam I ε δ : ℚ) / γParam I ε δ⌉₊

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ := I.m * I.n + I.m + I.n + 2

/-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. -/
noncomputable def WParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 100 * dParam I * BParam I ε δ

/-- `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def ηParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ε / ((200 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-- `τ = 2 K_obs (H + p + K + 5)`. -/
noncomputable def BretParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  2000 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 2 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) ^ 2 * τParam I ε δ

/-- `N_av = ⌈10⁸ p⁸ K_obs (H + 1) / η²⌉`. -/
noncomputable def NavParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈((100000000 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 8 * KobsParam I ε δ * (HParam I ε δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) /
    ηParam I ε δ ^ 2⌉₊

/-- `J_* = 100 (H + 1)(B_ret + N_av + p + d + 1)`. -/
abbrev rate : Rate Op := Rate.unit Op

/-- INTERNAL: charge `k` bit operations and return `a`.  Private, so it is not a
primitive a program can call; every public wrapper below fixes its own `k`. -/
private def bits {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell α :=
  Charged.opMany Op.bit k a

/-! ## Sealed naturals -/

/-- **A sealed natural number.**  Built only by the charged primitives of this
file, read only through them. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
inductive Op where
  /-- One bit operation. -/
  | bit
  /-- One randomness operation; the program performs only `RandOp.flip`. -/
  | rand (o : RandOp)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Every operation, as a list. -/
def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.size k + 1

/-- Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its
numerator and of its denominator. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × ℕ

/-- The retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive bound, in row-major
order.  Cells with `b_s = 0` are deleted; all vertices are retained. -/
noncomputable def cellRange (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  cellHigh I i j - cellLow I i j

/-- A cell of the tightened table: row, column, bound. -/
noncomputable def margin (I : Instance) (v : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if v < I.m then (tRow I v : ℚ) else (tCol I (v - I.m) : ℚ)

/-- The load of vertex `v` from the non-tree cells: a small cell adds `x_s` to
its row and `b_s - y_s` to its column (R1); a free cell adds `z_e` to both
endpoints. -/
structure RefRunState where
  /-- `w^(a)`, for the stages stored so far. -/
  ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ
  /-- `∏ R̂_j` so far. -/
  prod : ℝ
  /-- Some phase aborted. -/
  aborted : Bool

/-- **Reference phase `j`** (`algorithm.tex:214-249`), `Pseudocode.phase` with exact
weights and probabilities.
PAPER: sections/algorithm.tex:214-249 -/
noncomputable def refMu0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF (Finset ℕ) :=
  loop (fun s S => do
    let k ← uniformBelow (smallB I ε δ s + 1)
    let rank ← uniformBelow (Nat.choose (smallB I ε δ s) k)
    pure (S ∪ (Finset.range (smallB I ε δ s)).image fun t =>
      if t ∈ unrank (smallB I ε δ s) k rank then 2 * (cellFirst I ε δ s + t)
      else 2 * (cellFirst I ε δ s + t) + 1))
    (nSmall I ε δ) ∅

/-- INTERNAL: one iteration of the capped reference restart, `restartStep` with
the exact transition.
TEXLINE: sections/algorithm.tex:214-225 -/
noncomputable def refRestart (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (S0 : Finset ℕ) : PMF Restart :=
  loop (fun _ st => refRestartStep I ε δ ws j st) (BretParam I ε δ + 1)
    ⟨S0, 1, 0, 0, decide (j = 0), false

oracle_cost theorem oracle_cost : ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ (S : ℕ) (C : Ctx), 2 ≤ S → CtxSize S C → PenaltyOK S C → ∀ (x y : List SNat), ProfileValid C x y → ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ S → ∀ (ξin θ : SRat), 0 < ξin.get → 0 < θ.get → ξin.get⁻¹ ≤ S → θ.get⁻¹ ≤ S → ratLen ξin.get ≤ S → ratLen θ.get ≤ S → ∀ (tape : Coins ℕ) (cur : ℕ), Charged.steps rate (oracle C tape x y j ξin θ cur) ≤ S ^ k ∧ ratLen (oracle C tape x y j ξin θ cur).val.1.get ≤ S ^ k := by *Oracle cost.** PAPER: sections/evaluation.tex:27-28 ("On every execution its bit cost is bounded by a fixed polynomial in `L, ε⁻¹, ξ_in⁻¹, θ⁻¹` and the encoding lengths of the parameters", `prop:weight-oracle`); proof at sections/evaluation.tex:386-470. structure Ctx where
  /-- Number of rows. -/

  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Tightened row margins. -/

  /-- Tightened column margins. -/

  /-- Their number. -/

  /-- Free cells `F`: large cells outside the forest. -/
  free : List Entry
  /-- Their number `e`. -/
  nFree : ℕ
  /-- Tree cells `T`. -/
  tree : List Entry
  /-- Their number. -/
  nTree : ℕ
  /-- Leaf-elimination order: `(vertex, parent tree edge)`, leaves first. -/
  order : List (ℕ × ℕ)
  /-- One root per component. -/
  roots : List ℕ
  /-- `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. -/
  Mf : SNat
  /-- `d`. -/
  d : SNat
  /-- `B`. -/
  B : SNat
  /-- `H`. -/
  H : SNat
  /-- `A` as a rational. -/

  /-- `H` as a rational. -/
  Hq : SRat
  /-- `B` as a rational. -/
  Bq : SRat

/-- **S4**: the small/large split, the forest, roots, elimination order and
`M_f`. -/
structure CtxSize (S : ℕ) (C : Ctx) : Prop where
  m_le : C.m ≤ S
  n_le : C.n ≤ S
  rows_bits : ∀ x ∈ C.rows, bitLen x.get ≤ S
  cols_bits : ∀ x ∈ C.cols, bitLen x.get ≤ S
  nSmall_le : C.nSmall ≤ S
  small_le : ∀ e ∈ C.small, e.1 ≤ S ∧ e.2.1 ≤ S ∧ e.2.2.get ≤ S
  nFree_le : C.nFree ≤ S
  free_le : ∀ e ∈ C.free, e.1 ≤ S ∧ e.2.1 ≤ S ∧ bitLen e.2.2.get ≤ S
  nTree_le : C.nTree ≤ S
  tree_le : ∀ e ∈ C.tree, e.1 ≤ S ∧ e.2.1 ≤ S ∧ bitLen e.2.2.get ≤ S
  order_length : C.order.length ≤ S
  order_le : ∀ vt ∈ C.order, vt.1 ≤ S ∧ vt.2 ≤ S
  roots_length : C.roots.length ≤ S
  roots_le : ∀ v ∈ C.roots, v ≤ S
  Mf_bits : bitLen C.Mf.get ≤ S
  d_le : C.d.get ≤ S
  B_pos : 1 ≤ C.B.get
  B_le : C.B.get ≤ S
  H_pos : 1 ≤ C.H.get
  H_le : C.H.get ≤ S
  Aq_eq : ∃ A : ℕ, C.Aq.get = A ∧ A ≤ S
  Hq_eq : C.Hq.get = C.H.get
  Bq_eq : C.Bq.get = C.B.get

/-- INTERNAL: the values of the parameters of `eq:parameters` bounded by `S`. -/
def PenaltyOK (S : ℕ) (C : Ctx) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x y : List SNat) (zf : List SRat), ProfileValid C x y → FreeValid C zf →
    |(penalty C x y zf).val.get| ≤ S

/-- INTERNAL: `CtxSize` is monotone in the bound. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
def ProfileValid (C : Ctx) (x y : List SNat) : Prop :=
  ∀ k < C.nSmall, (x.getD k default).get ≤ (C.small.getD k default).2.2.get ∧
    (y.getD k default).get ≤ (C.small.getD k default).2.2.get

/-- INTERNAL: a free vector in the extended free box `∏_{e ∈ F} [0, b_e + 1]` of
`lem:forest` (`sections/scales.tex:133-135`), read the way `Program.penalty`
reads it. -/
structure SRat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℚ

namespace SNat

/-- The number held.  **Specification-only.** -/
def ratLen (q : ℚ) : ℕ := bitLen q.num.natAbs + bitLen q.den

/-- **The input length `L`** of `(m, n, r, c, b, ε, δ)`: the sum of the binary
lengths of `m`, `n`, every margin, every cell bound (including zero bounds),
and the two accuracy parameters. -/
noncomputable def tape (T : ℕ) : PMF (Coins ℕ) :=
  (tapeHeads T).map Coins.ofFinset

/-- **The tape length**: the most fair bits any execution of the algorithm on
`(I, ε, δ)` reads. -/
abbrev rate : Rate Op := Rate.unit Op

/-- INTERNAL: charge `k` bit operations and return `a`.  Private, so it is not a
primitive a program can call; every public wrapper below fixes its own `k`. -/
private def bits {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell α :=
  Charged.opMany Op.bit k a

/-! ## Sealed naturals -/

/-- **A sealed natural number.**  Built only by the charged primitives of this
file, read only through them. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × SNat

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def F : (C × Bool → ℤ) → ℝ := laminarWeight E.mE E.Rtot E.Gs E.ψs

/-- INTERNAL: the two views of a physical table. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/
noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (I.m + I.n)).filter fun v =>
    decide (∀ u < v, (forest I ε δ).comp u ≠ (forest I ε δ).comp v)

/-- Breadth-first discovery of `w` through tree edge `t`: visited set, queue,
and the discovered `(vertex, parent edge)` pairs, newest first. -/
noncomputable def Mf (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((forest I ε δ).free.map fun e => e.2.2 + 1).prod

/-! ## S5: the penalty `D(x, y, z)` (`eq:penalty`, `scales.tex:113-126`) -/

/-- Number of small cells. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.size k + 1

/-- Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its
numerator and of its denominator. -/
def eq (x y : SNat) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen x.raw + bitLen y.raw) (decide (x.raw = y.raw))

/-- The encoded length `bitLen x = Nat.size x + 1` of `Model/Prelude.lean`. -/
def FreeValid (C : Ctx) (zf : List SRat) : Prop :=
  ∀ k < C.nFree, 0 ≤ (zf.getD k default).get ∧
    (zf.getD k default).get ≤ (C.free.getD k default).2.2.get + 1

/-- INTERNAL: the penalty computed by the program is at most `S` in absolute
value on every box-valid profile and every point of the extended free box.
For the program's own context this is `0 ≤ D ≤ H` of `lem:forest`
(`sections/scales.tex:145-148`) together with `H ≤ S`.
TEXLINE: sections/evaluation.tex:45-50 -/
noncomputable def box (E : EdgeModel C Rw Cl) : Finset (C → ℤ) :=
  Fintype.piFinset fun c => Icc (E.lo c) (E.hi c)

/-- INTERNAL: the marginal mass of the value `k` at cell `t`. -/
def penalty (C : Ctx) (x y : List SNat) (zf : List SRat) : Prog SRat := do
  let zero ← SRat.lit 0
  let acc0 ← Operations.replicate (C.m + C.n) zero
  let acc1 ← Charged.repeatFor (fun k acc => do
    let s ← Operations.get C.small k
    let xs ← Operations.get x k
    let ys ← Operations.get y k
    let xq ← SNat.toRat xs
    let acc' ← addAt acc s.1 xq
    let cv ← SNat.sub s.2.2 ys
    let cq ← SNat.toRat cv
    addAt acc' (C.m + s.2.1) cq) C.nSmall acc0
  let acc2 ← Charged.repeatFor (fun k acc => do
    let e ← Operations.get C.free k
    let ze ← Operations.get zf k
    let acc' ← addAt acc e.1 ze
    addAt acc' (C.m + e.2.1) ze) C.nFree acc1
  let zt0 ← Operations.replicate C.nTree zero
  let st ← Charged.foldl (fun (st : List SRat × List SRat) (vt : ℕ × ℕ) => do
    let e ← Operations.get C.tree vt.2
    let marg ← margin C vt.1
    let av ← Operations.get st.1 vt.1
    let ztv ← SRat.sub marg av
    let zt ← Operations.set st.2 vt.2 ztv
    let atRow ← idxEq vt.1 e.1
    if atRow then do
      let acc ← addAt st.1 (C.m + e.2.1) ztv
      pure (acc, zt)
    else do
      let acc ← addAt st.1 e.1 ztv
      pure (acc, zt)) C.order (acc2, zt0)
  let rootSum ← Charged.foldl (fun s v => do
    let av ← Operations.get st.1 v
    let marg ← margin C v
    let dv ← SRat.sub av marg
    let a ← absQ dv
    SRat.add s a) C.roots zero
  let distSum ← Charged.repeatFor (fun t s => do
    let e ← Operations.get C.tree t
    let zv ← Operations.get st.2 t
    let bq ← SNat.toRat e.2.2
    let dd ← distQ zv bq
    let q ← SRat.div dd bq
    SRat.add s q) C.nTree zero
  let tot ← SRat.add rootSum distSum
  SRat.mul C.Aq tot

/-! ## S6: the weight oracle (`prop:weight-oracle`, `evaluation.tex:40-482`) -/

/-- The internal parameters of one oracle call (`evaluation.tex:327-354`). -/
noncomputable def tapeHeads : ℕ → PMF (Finset ℕ)
  | 0 => PMF.pure ∅

structure Instance where
  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/

  /-- Row margins `r_i`. -/
  r : Fin m → ℕ
  /-- Column margins `c_j`. -/

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
noncomputable def pSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((smallCells I ε δ).map fun e => e.2.2).sum

/-- Large cells by decreasing bound, ties in retained order: each cell is
inserted before the first one of strictly smaller bound. -/
noncomputable def HParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  10 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2 * (WParam I ε δ + 1)

/-! ## S4: small and large cells, the maximum spanning forest -/

/-- Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. -/
structure RefRunState where
  /-- `w^(a)`, for the stages stored so far. -/
  ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ
  /-- `∏ R̂_j` so far. -/
  prod : ℝ
  /-- Some phase aborted. -/
  aborted : Bool

/-- **Reference phase `j`** (`algorithm.tex:214-249`), `Pseudocode.phase` with exact
weights and probabilities.
PAPER: sections/algorithm.tex:214-249 -/
def goodMult (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i < pSmall I ε δ, ∀ l < pSmall I ε δ, i ≠ l →
    Cpart I ε δ j / (4 * cDef I ε δ j i l) ≤ (w i l : ℝ) ∧
      (w i l : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Cpart I ε δ j / cDef I ε δ j i l

end Cellcounting.Analysis

noncomputable def refPhase (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (st : RefRunState) :
    PMF RefRunState :=
  if st.aborted then pure st else do
    let S0 ← refMu0 I ε δ
    let rs ← refRestart I ε δ st.ws j S0
    if rs.aborted then pure { st with aborted := true } else do
      let o ← refObserve I ε δ j (st.ws j) rs.S
      if 0 < o.n0 ∧ ∀ i < pSmall I ε δ, ∀ l < pSmall I ε δ, i ≠ l → 0 < o.nT i l then
        let R := (o.sumG / (NavParam I ε δ : ℝ)) / ((o.n0 : ℝ) / (NavParam I ε δ : ℝ))
        if j + 1 < HParam I ε δ then
          pure ⟨Function.update st.ws (j + 1) (refUpdateW (pSmall I ε δ) (st.ws j) o),
            st.prod * R, false⟩
        else pure ⟨st.ws, st.prod * R, false⟩
      else pure { st with aborted := true }

/-- **The reference experiment** (`algorithm.tex:251-257`): phases `j = 0..H-1`
from `w^(0)`; output `Z_ref = C(0) ∏_j R̂_j`, or `0` after an abort.
PAPER: sections/algorithm.tex:251-257 -/
def phaseOK (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (st st' : RefRunState) : Prop :=
  st'.aborted = false ∧
    (∀ a ≤ j, st'.ws a = st.ws a) ∧
    (j + 1 < HParam I ε δ → goodMult I ε δ (j + 1) (st'.ws (j + 1))) ∧
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ st'.prod = st.prod * R ∧
      |Real.log (R / (Cpart I ε δ (j + 1) / Cpart I ε δ j))| ≤ 4 * (ηParam I ε δ : ℝ)

/-- **One reference phase** (`prop:annealing`, the conditional step): from a
non-aborted state whose stored multipliers `w^(0..j)` are good, phase `j` fails
with probability at most `2/[100(H+1)]`.
PAPER: sections/algorithm.tex:278-371 -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈(4 * KParam I ε δ : ℚ) / γParam I ε δ⌉₊

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ := I.m * I.n + I.m + I.n + 2

/-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. -/
noncomputable def WParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 100 * dParam I * BParam I ε δ

/-- `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def phase (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (st : RunState) : PMF RunState :=
  if st.aborted then pure st else do
    let S0 ← mu0 I ε δ
    let rs ← restart I ε δ st.ws j S0
    if rs.aborted then pure { st with aborted := true } else do
      let o ← observe I ε δ j (st.ws j) rs.S
      if allPositive (pSmall I ε δ) o then
        let R := (o.sumG / (NavParam I ε δ : ℚ)) / ((o.n0 : ℚ) / (NavParam I ε δ : ℚ))
        if j + 1 < HParam I ε δ then
          pure ⟨Function.update st.ws (j + 1) (updateW (pSmall I ε δ) (st.ws j) o),
            st.prod * R, false⟩
        else pure ⟨st.ws, st.prod * R, false⟩
      else pure { st with aborted := true }

/-! ## S11: one annealing run -/

/-- **S11** (`algorithm.tex:251-254`), `p ≥ 1`: phases `j = 0..H-1` from `w^(0)`;
output `C(0) ∏_j R̂_j`, or `0` after an abort. -/
noncomputable def Cpart (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x ∈ smallBox I ε δ,
    hWeight I ε δ j (extendN x) (fun s => smallB I ε δ s - extendN x s)

/-- INTERNAL: a nonnegative sum over a union is at most the sum of the sums. -/
noncomputable def cDef (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j i l : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ S ∈ (refStates I ε δ).filter (fun S => kind I ε δ S = .defect i l), fWeight I ε δ j S

/-- **Good multipliers** (`eq:good-multipliers`): `C(j)/(4 c_il(j)) ≤ w_il ≤ 4 C(j)/c_il(j)`
for every ordered pair of distinct labels `i ≠ l < p`.
PAPER: sections/transport.tex:50-54 -/
noncomputable def refMu0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF (Finset ℕ) :=
  loop (fun s S => do
    let k ← uniformBelow (smallB I ε δ s + 1)
    let rank ← uniformBelow (Nat.choose (smallB I ε δ s) k)
    pure (S ∪ (Finset.range (smallB I ε δ s)).image fun t =>
      if t ∈ unrank (smallB I ε δ s) k rank then 2 * (cellFirst I ε δ s + t)
      else 2 * (cellFirst I ε δ s + t) + 1))
    (nSmall I ε δ) ∅

/-- INTERNAL: one iteration of the capped reference restart, `restartStep` with
the exact transition.
TEXLINE: sections/algorithm.tex:214-225 -/
noncomputable def refRestart (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (S0 : Finset ℕ) : PMF Restart :=
  loop (fun _ st => refRestartStep I ε δ ws j st) (BretParam I ε δ + 1)
    ⟨S0, 1, 0, 0, decide (j = 0), false⟩

/-- INTERNAL: the reference observation tallies; `sumG` is real.
TEXLINE: sections/algorithm.tex:226-233 -/
noncomputable def refObserve (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (S0 : Finset ℕ) :
    PMF RefObs :=
  loop (fun _ o => (refStep I ε δ j w o.S).map fun S' => refObserveState I ε δ j { o with S := S' })
    (NavParam I ε δ - 1) (refObserveState I ε δ j ⟨S0, 0, fun _ _ => 0, 0⟩)

/-- INTERNAL: the multiplier update `eq:alg-multiplier-update` on reference tallies.
TEXLINE: sections/algorithm.tex:242-247 -/
noncomputable def NavParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈((100000000 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 8 * KobsParam I ε δ * (HParam I ε δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) /
    ηParam I ε δ ^ 2⌉₊

/-- `J_* = 100 (H + 1)(B_ret + N_av + p + d + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def refUpdateW (p : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (o : RefObs) : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ := fun i l =>
  if i < p ∧ l < p ∧ i ≠ l then w i l * (o.n0 : ℚ) / (o.nT i l : ℚ) else w i l

/-- INTERNAL: the reference run in progress: stored multipliers, `∏ R̂`, abort flag.
TEXLINE: sections/algorithm.tex:251-254 -/
noncomputable def output (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF ℚ :=
  (run I ε δ).map Charged.val

end Cellcounting

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/

abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
structure Forest where
  /-- Tree cells `T`, in insertion order. -/
  tree : List Entry
  /-- Free cells `F`, in insertion order. -/
  free : List Entry
  /-- Component label of each vertex. -/
  comp : ℕ → ℕ

/-- One Kruskal step (`scales.tex:91-99`): a cell joining two current components
enters the tree and the components merge; otherwise it is free. -/
noncomputable def sortedLarge (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (largeCells I ε δ).foldl
    (fun acc x => acc.orderedInsert (fun a b : Entry => b.2.2 < a.2.2) x) []

/-- Kruskal's state: tree cells, free cells, and a component label per vertex
(rows `0..m-1`, columns `m..m+n-1`). -/
noncomputable def kruskalStep (m : ℕ) (F : Forest) (e : Entry) : Forest :=
  if F.comp e.1 = F.comp (m + e.2.1) then
    { F with free := F.free ++ [e] }
  else
    { F with
      tree := F.tree ++ [e]
      comp := fun w => if F.comp w = F.comp (m + e.2.1) then F.comp e.1 else F.comp w }

/-- **S4**: the maximum-capacity spanning forest of the large-cell graph. -/
noncomputable def asgBox (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    Finset ((Fin (nSmall I ε δ) → ℕ) × (Fin (nFree I ε δ) → ℕ)) :=
  smallBox I ε δ ×ˢ freeBox I ε δ

/-- INTERNAL: the column view `y_s = b_s - x_s` of a balanced small profile. -/
noncomputable def asgTree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (p : (Fin (nSmall I ε δ) → ℕ) × (Fin (nFree I ε δ) → ℕ)) : ℕ → ℚ :=
  (treeValues I ε δ (extendN p.1) (balY I ε δ p.1) (extendQ p.2)).2

/-- INTERNAL: the tree marginal `a_t(k)` of `eq:tree-marginal-definition`.
TEXLINE: sections/integer-signatures.tex:420-430 -/
noncomputable def asgPen (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (p : (Fin (nSmall I ε δ) → ℕ) × (Fin (nFree I ε δ) → ℕ)) : ℚ :=
  penalty I ε δ (extendN p.1) (balY I ε δ p.1) (extendQ p.2)

/-- INTERNAL: the tree values `z_t` of an assignment (the unique nonroot
completion, `lem:forest`).

/-- INTERNAL: charge `k` bit operations and return `a`.  Private, so it is not a
primitive a program can call; every public wrapper below fixes its own `k`. -/
private def bits {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell α :=

/-! ## Sealed naturals -/

/-- **A sealed natural number.**  Built only by the charged primitives of this
file, read only through them. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
inductive Op where
  /-- One bit operation. -/
  | bit
  /-- One randomness operation; the program performs only `RandOp.flip`. -/
  | rand (o : RandOp)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Every operation, as a list. -/
def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.size k + 1

/-- Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its
numerator and of its denominator. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × ℕ

/-- The retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive bound, in row-major
order.  Cells with `b_s = 0` are deleted; all vertices are retained. -/
noncomputable def F : (C × Bool → ℤ) → ℝ := laminarWeight E.mE E.Rtot E.Gs E.ψs

/-- INTERNAL: the two views of a physical table. -/
noncomputable def step (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (a : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    PMF (Finset ℕ) := do
  let hold ← ProbRAM.fair
  if hold then pure S else do
    let u1 ← dyadicDraw (pSmall I ε δ) (ξParam I ε δ)
    let u2 ← dyadicDraw (pSmall I ε δ) (ξParam I ε δ)
    let S' := insert (nthWith I ε δ S false u2) (S.erase (nthWith I ε δ S true u1))
    match kind I ε δ S' with
    | .outside => pure S
    | k' => do
      let lNew ← lam I ε δ S' k' a w
      let lOld ← lam I ε δ S (kind I ε δ S) a w
      let ok ← acceptTest I ε δ (min 1 (lNew / lOld))
      pure (if ok then S' else S)

/-! ## S9a: the fresh `μ₀` draw and the capped restart -/

/-- Lexicographic unranking: the `r`-th `k`-subset of `[0, b)`, built greedily
(include `t` iff `r < C(b - t - 1, k' - 1)` for the `k'` still to choose). -/
noncomputable def largeCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => ¬ e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- `p = Σ_{s small} b_s`. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/
noncomputable def smallBox (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Finset (Fin (nSmall I ε δ) → ℕ) :=
  Fintype.piFinset fun s => Finset.range (smallB I ε δ s + 1)

/-- INTERNAL: the assignments `(x, z)` summed in `C(j)`: balanced small profiles
times the free box.
TEXLINE: sections/scales.tex:279-282 -/
noncomputable def freeBox (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Finset (Fin (nFree I ε δ) → ℕ) :=
  Fintype.piFinset fun k => Finset.range ((freeAt I ε δ k).2.2 + 1)

/-- INTERNAL: a vector on `Fin N`, read as the `ℕ → ℚ` the penalty takes
(zero past `N`, a position the penalty never reads). -/
noncomputable def treeValues (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) :
    (ℕ → ℚ) × (ℕ → ℚ) :=
  (elimOrder I ε δ).foldl (fun st vt =>
    let e := treeAt I ε δ vt.2
    let ztv := margin I vt.1 - st.1 vt.1
    let other := if vt.1 = e.1 then I.m + e.2.1 else e.1
    (Function.update st.1 other (st.1 other + ztv), Function.update st.2 vt.2 ztv))
    (baseLoad I ε δ x y z, fun _ => 0)

/-- `dist(x, [0, b])`. -/
def extendN {N : ℕ} (x : Fin N → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => if h : k < N then x ⟨k, h⟩ else 0

/-- INTERNAL: the balanced small profiles, parametrised by `x ∈ ∏_s {0..b_s}`
(`y_s = b_s - x_s`).
TEXLINE: sections/scales.tex:279-282 -/
noncomputable def balY (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x : Fin (nSmall I ε δ) → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ :=
  fun s => smallB I ε δ s - extendN x s

/-- INTERNAL: the penalty `D(x, y, z)` of an assignment.
TEXLINE: sections/scales.tex:113-126 -/
def extendQ {N : ℕ} (z : Fin N → ℕ) : ℕ → ℚ := fun k => if h : k < N then (z ⟨k, h⟩ : ℚ) else 0

/-- INTERNAL: a vector on `Fin N`, read as an `ℕ → ℕ` (zero past `N`). -/
def eq (x y : SNat) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen x.raw + bitLen y.raw) (decide (x.raw = y.raw))

/-- The encoded length `bitLen x = Nat.size x + 1` of `Model/Prelude.lean`. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/
def Op.all : List Op :=
  [.bit, .rand .flip, .rand .accept, .rand .halve, .rand .inflate]

/-- The currency is finite, so `CostVec.steps` can sum over it. -/
instance : Fintype Op :=
  Fintype.ofList Op.all (by intro o; cases o with
    | bit => decide
    | rand r => cases r <;> decide)

/-- The randomness operations, filed under `Op.rand`. -/
noncomputable def laminarWeight (m : ι → ℤ) (R : ℤ) (G : α → Finset ι) (ψ : α → ℤ → ℝ) :

/-- A constant or an input number, at the price of its length. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × SNat

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/
noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/

  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/
noncomputable def elimOrder (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  let T := (forest I ε δ).tree

    match st.2.1[k]? with
    | none => st
    | some u => (List.range T.length).foldl (fun st' t =>

        if e.1 = u then visit (I.m + e.2.1) t st'
        else if I.m + e.2.1 = u then visit e.1 t st' else st') st)

/-- Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. -/

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
structure SRat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℚ

namespace SNat

/-- The number held.  **Specification-only.** -/
def penalty (C : Ctx) (x y : List SNat) (zf : List SRat) : Prog SRat := do
  let zero ← SRat.lit 0
  let acc0 ← Operations.replicate (C.m + C.n) zero
  let acc1 ← Charged.repeatFor (fun k acc => do
    let s ← Operations.get C.small k
    let xs ← Operations.get x k
    let ys ← Operations.get y k
    let xq ← SNat.toRat xs
    let acc' ← addAt acc s.1 xq
    let cv ← SNat.sub s.2.2 ys
    let cq ← SNat.toRat cv
    addAt acc' (C.m + s.2.1) cq) C.nSmall acc0
  let acc2 ← Charged.repeatFor (fun k acc => do
    let e ← Operations.get C.free k
    let ze ← Operations.get zf k
    let acc' ← addAt acc e.1 ze
    addAt acc' (C.m + e.2.1) ze) C.nFree acc1
  let zt0 ← Operations.replicate C.nTree zero
  let st ← Charged.foldl (fun (st : List SRat × List SRat) (vt : ℕ × ℕ) => do
    let e ← Operations.get C.tree vt.2
    let marg ← margin C vt.1
    let av ← Operations.get st.1 vt.1
    let ztv ← SRat.sub marg av
    let zt ← Operations.set st.2 vt.2 ztv
    let atRow ← idxEq vt.1 e.1
    if atRow then do
      let acc ← addAt st.1 (C.m + e.2.1) ztv
      pure (acc, zt)
    else do
      let acc ← addAt st.1 e.1 ztv
      pure (acc, zt)) C.order (acc2, zt0)
  let rootSum ← Charged.foldl (fun s v => do
    let av ← Operations.get st.1 v
    let marg ← margin C v
    let dv ← SRat.sub av marg
    let a ← absQ dv
    SRat.add s a) C.roots zero
  let distSum ← Charged.repeatFor (fun t s => do
    let e ← Operations.get C.tree t
    let zv ← Operations.get st.2 t
    let bq ← SNat.toRat e.2.2
    let dd ← distQ zv bq
    let q ← SRat.div dd bq
    SRat.add s q) C.nTree zero
  let tot ← SRat.add rootSum distSum
  SRat.mul C.Aq tot

/-- The internal parameters of one oracle call (`evaluation.tex:327-354`). -/
noncomputable def penalty (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (AParam I ε δ : ℚ) *
    (((roots I ε δ).map fun v => |(treeValues I ε δ x y z).1 v - margin I v|).sum +
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (forest I ε δ).tree.length,
        boxDist ((treeValues I ε δ x y z).2 t) ((treeAt I ε δ t).2.2 : ℚ) /
          ((treeAt I ε δ t).2.2 : ℚ))

/-! ## S6: the weight oracle (`prop:weight-oracle`, `evaluation.tex:40-482`) -/

/-- `σ = ξ_in / (50 (H + 1))`. -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
noncomputable def F : (C × Bool → ℤ) → ℝ := laminarWeight E.mE E.Rtot E.Gs E.ψs

/-- INTERNAL: the two views of a physical table. -/
noncomputable def cellLow (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  if h : I.Omega.Nonempty then (I.Omega.image fun X => X i j).min' (h.image _) else 0

/-- `u_ij`, the greatest value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω`. -/
noncomputable def margin (I : Instance) (v : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if v < I.m then (tRow I v : ℚ) else (tCol I (v - I.m) : ℚ)

/-- The load of vertex `v` from the non-tree cells: a small cell adds `x_s` to
its row and `b_s - y_s` to its column (R1); a free cell adds `z_e` to both
endpoints. -/
def eq (x y : SNat) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen x.raw + bitLen y.raw) (decide (x.raw = y.raw))

/-- The encoded length `bitLen x = Nat.size x + 1` of `Model/Prelude.lean`. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × ℕ

/-- The retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive bound, in row-major
order.  Cells with `b_s = 0` are deleted; all vertices are retained. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j)

  let sq ← SNat.toRat P.sPrime
  let t ← SRat.mul β sq
  let halfQ ← SRat.lit (1 / 2)
  let t' ← SRat.add t halfQ
  let h ← SRat.floor t'
  let target ← SRat.zpow2 h
  let lo ← SRat.lit 0
  let hi ← SRat.lit 8
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ (st : SRat × SRat) => do
    let s ← SRat.add st.1 st.2
    let mid ← SRat.mul s halfQ
    let pw ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ acc => SRat.mul acc acc) P.ks mid
    let below ← SRat.le pw target
    if below then pure (mid, st.2) else pure (st.1, mid)) P.depth (lo, hi)

/-- Uniform integer offsets in the bin intervals

`ζ`; returns the integer point `z`, the product `∏ |I_{v_e}|`, and the cursor. -/
def oracleParams (C : Ctx) (ξin θ : SRat) : Prog OParams := do
  let one ← SNat.lit 1

  let H1q ← SNat.toRat H1

  let σ ← SRat.div ξin den
  -- N_in = ⌈10⁶ (H + 1) / (θ σ²)⌉

  let num ← SRat.mul c1e6 H1q
  let σ2 ← SRat.mul σ σ
  let θσ2 ← SRat.mul θ σ2
  let nq ← SRat.div num θσ2
  let N ← SRat.natCeil nq
  let NI ← SNat.index N
  let Nq ← SNat.toRat N
  -- Q_in = (d + 1)(H + 1) N_in
  let d1 ← SNat.add C.d one
  let dH ← SNat.mul d1 H1
  let Q ← SNat.mul dH N
  let Qq ← SNat.toRat Q
  -- K_bin = 2 (10⁴ d² B)²
  let d2 ← SNat.mul C.d C.d
  let c1e4 ← SNat.lit 10000
  let t ← SNat.mul c1e4 d2
  let t' ← SNat.mul t C.B
  let t2 ← SNat.mul t' t'
  let two ← SNat.lit 2

  let s ← SNat.add C.H dB

  let s2q ← SNat.toRat s2
  let c16 ← SRat.lit 16
  let q16 ← SRat.mul c16 Qq
  let q16θ ← SRat.div q16 θ
  let inner ← SRat.add s2q q16θ
  let Kq ← SNat.toRat Kbin
  let ellq ← SRat.mul Kq inner
  let ellN ← SRat.natCeil ellq
  let ell ← SNat.index ellN
  -- ⌈log₂ (4d)⌉
  let c4 ← SNat.lit 4
  let d4 ← SNat.mul c4 C.d
  let kdN ← clog2 d4
  let kd ← SNat.index kdN
  -- 2e and B - 1
  let eS ← SNat.lit C.nFree
  let twoE ← SNat.mul two eS
  let Bm1 ← SNat.sub C.B one
  -- ζ = θ / (8 Q_in)
  let c8 ← SRat.lit 8
  let q8 ← SRat.mul c8 Qq
  let ζ ← SRat.div θ q8
  -- s' = 2^⌈log₂ ⌈32/σ⌉⌉, the power of two in [32/σ, 64/σ]
  let c32 ← SRat.lit 32
  let r32 ← SRat.div c32 σ
  let c32N ← SRat.natCeil r32
  let ksN ← clog2 c32N
  let ks ← SNat.index ksN
  let sPrime ← SNat.pow2 ksN
  -- depth = ⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉
  let c512 ← SRat.lit 512
  let r512 ← SRat.div c512 σ
  let c512N ← SRat.natCeil r512
  let depN ← clog2 c512N
  let depth ← SNat.index depN
  -- B^e
  let Be ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ acc => SNat.mul acc C.B) C.nFree one
  pure ⟨NI, Nq, ell, kd, twoE, Bm1, ζ, ks, sPrime, depth, Be⟩

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/
noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/
noncomputable def elimOrder (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  let T := (forest I ε δ).tree
  ((List.range (I.m + I.n)).foldl (fun st k =>
    match st.2.1[k]? with
    | none => st
    | some u => (List.range T.length).foldl (fun st' t =>
        let e := T.getD t (0, 0, 0)
        if e.1 = u then visit (I.m + e.2.1) t st'
        else if I.m + e.2.1 = u then visit e.1 t st' else st') st)
    ((roots I ε δ).toFinset, roots I ε δ, [])).2.2

/-- `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (I.m + I.n)).filter fun v =>
    decide (∀ u < v, (forest I ε δ).comp u ≠ (forest I ε δ).comp v)

and the discovered `(vertex, parent edge)` pairs, newest first. -/
noncomputable def Mf (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((forest I ε δ).free.map fun e => e.2.2 + 1).prod

def walkStep (C : Ctx) (P : OParams) (tape : Coins ℕ) (aq : SRat) (x y : List SNat)
    (st : List SNat × ℕ) : Prog (List SNat × ℕ) := do
  let (u, cur) ← uniformBits tape P.kd st.2
  let moves ← SNat.lt u P.twoE
  if moves then do
    let two ← SNat.lit 2
    let one ← SNat.lit 1
    let zero ← SNat.lit 0
    let coord ← SNat.div u two
    let dir ← SNat.mod u two
    let ci ← SNat.index coord
    let vc ← Operations.get st.1 ci
    let up ← SNat.eq dir one
    if up then do
      let edge ← SNat.eq vc P.Bm1
      if edge then pure (st.1, cur) else do
        let vc' ← SNat.add vc one
        let w ← Operations.set st.1 ci vc'
        binAccept C tape aq x y st.1 w cur
    else do
      let edge ← SNat.eq vc zero
      if edge then pure (st.1, cur) else do
        let vc' ← SNat.sub vc one
        let w ← Operations.set st.1 ci vc'
        binAccept C tape aq x y st.1 w cur
  else pure (st.1, cur)

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
structure Ctx where
  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Tightened row margins. -/

  /-- Tightened column margins. -/

/-- **S4**: the small/large split, the forest, roots, elimination order and
`M_f`. -/
noncomputable def get (x : SNat) : ℕ := x.raw

/-- A constant or an input number, at the price of its length. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × SNat

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/
noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/
noncomputable def elimOrder (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  let T := (forest I ε δ).tree
  ((List.range (I.m + I.n)).foldl (fun st k =>
    match st.2.1[k]? with
    | none => st
    | some u => (List.range T.length).foldl (fun st' t =>
        let e := T.getD t (0, 0, 0)
        if e.1 = u then visit (I.m + e.2.1) t st'
        else if I.m + e.2.1 = u then visit e.1 t st' else st') st)
    ((roots I ε δ).toFinset, roots I ε δ, [])).2.2

/-- `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (I.m + I.n)).filter fun v =>
    decide (∀ u < v, (forest I ε δ).comp u ≠ (forest I ε δ).comp v)

/-- Breadth-first discovery of `w` through tree edge `t`: visited set, queue,
and the discovered `(vertex, parent edge)` pairs, newest first. -/
noncomputable def Mf (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((forest I ε δ).free.map fun e => e.2.2 + 1).prod

/-! ## S5: the penalty `D(x, y, z)` (`eq:penalty`, `scales.tex:113-126`) -/

/-- Number of small cells. -/
noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ := I.m * I.n + I.m + I.n + 2

/-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. -/
noncomputable def BParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 16 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2

/-- `W = 100 d B`. -/
noncomputable def HParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  10 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2 * (WParam I ε δ + 1)

/-! ## S4: small and large cells, the maximum spanning forest -/

/-- Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈(4 * KParam I ε δ : ℚ) / γParam I ε δ⌉₊

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
structure SRat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℚ

namespace SNat

/-- The number held.  **Specification-only.** -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
def sampleBin (C : Ctx) (P : OParams) (tape : Coins ℕ) (aq : SRat) (x y : List SNat)
    (cur : ℕ) : Prog (List SNat × ℕ) := do
  let noFree ← idxEq C.nFree 0
  if noFree then pure ([], cur) else do
    let zero ← SNat.lit 0
    let v0 ← Operations.replicate C.nFree zero
    Charged.repeatFor (fun _ st => walkStep C P tape aq x y st) P.ell (v0, cur)

/-- The average of `N_in` samples of `V_{a+1}(v)/V_a(v) = 2^{k_a(v) - k_{a+1}(v)}`,
`v` from fresh bin walks for `V_a`: the estimate of `R_a`. -/
def oracleParams (C : Ctx) (ξin θ : SRat) : Prog OParams := do
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let H1 ← SNat.add C.H one
  let H1q ← SNat.toRat H1
  -- σ = ξ_in / (50 (H + 1))
  let c50 ← SRat.lit 50
  let den ← SRat.mul c50 H1q
  let σ ← SRat.div ξin den
  -- N_in = ⌈10⁶ (H + 1) / (θ σ²)⌉
  let c1e6 ← SRat.lit 1000000
  let num ← SRat.mul c1e6 H1q
  let σ2 ← SRat.mul σ σ
  let θσ2 ← SRat.mul θ σ2
  let nq ← SRat.div num θσ2
  let N ← SRat.natCeil nq
  let NI ← SNat.index N
  let Nq ← SNat.toRat N
  -- Q_in = (d + 1)(H + 1) N_in
  let d1 ← SNat.add C.d one
  let dH ← SNat.mul d1 H1
  let Q ← SNat.mul dH N
  let Qq ← SNat.toRat Q
  -- K_bin = 2 (10⁴ d² B)²
  let d2 ← SNat.mul C.d C.d
  let c1e4 ← SNat.lit 10000
  let t ← SNat.mul c1e4 d2
  let t' ← SNat.mul t C.B
  let t2 ← SNat.mul t' t'
  let two ← SNat.lit 2
  let Kbin ← SNat.mul two t2
  -- ℓ_in = ⌈K_bin (H + dB + 16 Q_in/θ + 2)⌉
  let dB ← SNat.mul C.d C.B
  let s ← SNat.add C.H dB
  let s2 ← SNat.add s two
  let s2q ← SNat.toRat s2
  let c16 ← SRat.lit 16
  let q16 ← SRat.mul c16 Qq
  let q16θ ← SRat.div q16 θ
  let inner ← SRat.add s2q q16θ
  let Kq ← SNat.toRat Kbin
  let ellq ← SRat.mul Kq inner
  let ellN ← SRat.natCeil ellq
  let ell ← SNat.index ellN
  -- ⌈log₂ (4d)⌉
  let c4 ← SNat.lit 4
  let d4 ← SNat.mul c4 C.d
  let kdN ← clog2 d4
  let kd ← SNat.index kdN
  -- 2e and B - 1
  let eS ← SNat.lit C.nFree
  let twoE ← SNat.mul two eS
  let Bm1 ← SNat.sub C.B one
  -- ζ = θ / (8 Q_in)
  let c8 ← SRat.lit 8
  let q8 ← SRat.mul c8 Qq
  let ζ ← SRat.div θ q8
  -- s' = 2^⌈log₂ ⌈32/σ⌉⌉, the power of two in [32/σ, 64/σ]
  let c32 ← SRat.lit 32
  let r32 ← SRat.div c32 σ
  let c32N ← SRat.natCeil r32
  let ksN ← clog2 c32N
  let ks ← SNat.index ksN
  let sPrime ← SNat.pow2 ksN
  -- depth = ⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉
  let c512 ← SRat.lit 512
  let r512 ← SRat.div c512 σ
  let c512N ← SRat.natCeil r512
  let depN ← clog2 c512N
  let depth ← SNat.index depN
  -- B^e
  let Be ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ acc => SNat.mul acc C.B) C.nFree one
  pure ⟨NI, Nq, ell, kd, twoE, Bm1, ζ, ks, sPrime, depth, Be⟩

/-- `⌊a·D/H⌋`, the exponent with `V_a = 2^{-⌊a D/H⌋}`. -/
noncomputable def tapeHeads : ℕ → PMF (Finset ℕ)
  | 0 => PMF.pure ∅
  | T + 1 => (tapeHeads T).bind fun s =>
      ProbRAM.fair.bind fun b => PMF.pure (if b then insert T s else s)

/-- `T` independent fair bits at positions `0..T-1` (tails beyond), as the
program's sealed coin family. -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
noncomputable def F : (C × Bool → ℤ) → ℝ := laminarWeight E.mE E.Rtot E.Gs E.ψs

/-- INTERNAL: the two views of a physical table. -/
noncomputable def cellLow (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  if h : I.Omega.Nonempty then (I.Omega.image fun X => X i j).min' (h.image _) else 0

/-- `u_ij`, the greatest value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω`. -/
noncomputable def margin (I : Instance) (v : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if v < I.m then (tRow I v : ℚ) else (tCol I (v - I.m) : ℚ)

/-- A constant or an input number, at the price of its length. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × SNat

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/
noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/

  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/

        else if I.m + e.2.1 = u then visit e.1 t st' else st') st)
    ((roots I ε δ).toFinset, roots I ε δ, [])).2.2

/-- `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
structure SRat where

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
def corrAvg (C : Ctx) (P : OParams) (tape : Coins ℕ) (x y : List SNat) (j : ℕ)
    (cur : ℕ) : Prog (SRat × ℕ) := do
  let jS ← SNat.lit j
  let jq ← SNat.toRat jS
  let zero ← SRat.lit 0
  let Mq ← SNat.toRat C.Mf
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ (st : SRat × ℕ) => do
    let (v, cur1) ← sampleBin C P tape jq x y st.2
    let kv ← binExp C jq x y v
    let (z, lenProd, cur2) ← binOffsets C P tape v cur1
    let Dz ← penalty C x y z
    let t ← SRat.mul jq Dz
    let u ← SRat.div t C.Hq
    let β ← SRat.sub kv u
    let approx ← pow2Approx P β
    let BeI ← SNat.mul P.Be lenProd
    let BeIq ← SNat.toRat BeI
    let α ← SRat.div BeIq Mq
    let sample ← SRat.mul α approx
    let s ← SRat.add st.1 sample
    pure (s, cur2)) P.N (zero, cur)
  let avg ← SRat.div st.1 P.Nq
  pure (avg, st.2)

/-- **The weight oracle** `ĥ_j(x, y)`: `M_f · ∏_{a<j} R̂_a · T̂`, every call on
fresh bits. -/
def oracleParams (C : Ctx) (ξin θ : SRat) : Prog OParams := do
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let H1 ← SNat.add C.H one
  let H1q ← SNat.toRat H1
  -- σ = ξ_in / (50 (H + 1))
  let c50 ← SRat.lit 50
  let den ← SRat.mul c50 H1q
  let σ ← SRat.div ξin den
  -- N_in = ⌈10⁶ (H + 1) / (θ σ²)⌉

  let num ← SRat.mul c1e6 H1q
  let σ2 ← SRat.mul σ σ
  let θσ2 ← SRat.mul θ σ2
  let nq ← SRat.div num θσ2
  let N ← SRat.natCeil nq
  let NI ← SNat.index N
  let Nq ← SNat.toRat N
  -- Q_in = (d + 1)(H + 1) N_in
  let d1 ← SNat.add C.d one
  let dH ← SNat.mul d1 H1
  let Q ← SNat.mul dH N
  let Qq ← SNat.toRat Q
  -- K_bin = 2 (10⁴ d² B)²
  let d2 ← SNat.mul C.d C.d
  let c1e4 ← SNat.lit 10000
  let t ← SNat.mul c1e4 d2
  let t' ← SNat.mul t C.B
  let t2 ← SNat.mul t' t'
  let two ← SNat.lit 2
  let Kbin ← SNat.mul two t2
  -- ℓ_in = ⌈K_bin (H + dB + 16 Q_in/θ + 2)⌉
  let dB ← SNat.mul C.d C.B
  let s ← SNat.add C.H dB
  let s2 ← SNat.add s two
  let s2q ← SNat.toRat s2
  let c16 ← SRat.lit 16
  let q16 ← SRat.mul c16 Qq
  let q16θ ← SRat.div q16 θ
  let inner ← SRat.add s2q q16θ
  let Kq ← SNat.toRat Kbin
  let ellq ← SRat.mul Kq inner
  let ellN ← SRat.natCeil ellq
  let ell ← SNat.index ellN
  -- ⌈log₂ (4d)⌉
  let c4 ← SNat.lit 4
  let d4 ← SNat.mul c4 C.d
  let kdN ← clog2 d4
  let kd ← SNat.index kdN
  -- 2e and B - 1
  let eS ← SNat.lit C.nFree
  let twoE ← SNat.mul two eS
  let Bm1 ← SNat.sub C.B one
  -- ζ = θ / (8 Q_in)
  let c8 ← SRat.lit 8
  let q8 ← SRat.mul c8 Qq
  let ζ ← SRat.div θ q8
  -- s' = 2^⌈log₂ ⌈32/σ⌉⌉, the power of two in [32/σ, 64/σ]
  let c32 ← SRat.lit 32
  let r32 ← SRat.div c32 σ
  let c32N ← SRat.natCeil r32
  let ksN ← clog2 c32N
  let ks ← SNat.index ksN
  let sPrime ← SNat.pow2 ksN
  -- depth = ⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉
  let c512 ← SRat.lit 512
  let r512 ← SRat.div c512 σ
  let c512N ← SRat.natCeil r512
  let depN ← clog2 c512N
  let depth ← SNat.index depN
  -- B^e
  let Be ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ acc => SNat.mul acc C.B) C.nFree one
  pure ⟨NI, Nq, ell, kd, twoE, Bm1, ζ, ks, sPrime, depth, Be⟩

/-- `⌊a·D/H⌋`, the exponent with `V_a = 2^{-⌊a D/H⌋}`. -/
noncomputable def tapeHeads : ℕ → PMF (Finset ℕ)
  | 0 => PMF.pure ∅
  | T + 1 => (tapeHeads T).bind fun s =>

program's sealed coin family. -/

step. -/

  let P ← oracleParams C ξin θ
  let one ← SRat.lit 1

program's sealed coin family. -/

  (largeCells I ε δ).foldl

  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Row margins `r_i`. -/
  r : Fin m → ℕ
  /-- Column margins `c_j`. -/
  c : Fin n → ℕ
  /-- Cell upper bounds `b_ij`; zero is allowed. -/
  b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
structure Chain where
  /-- `p`, the number of pairs. -/
  p : ℕ
  /-- `p`, sealed. -/
  pS : SNat
  /-- Number of small cells. -/
  nsm : ℕ
  /-- `s(i)`, the small cell of pair `i`. -/
  pairCell : List ℕ
  /-- The first pair label of each small cell. -/
  cellFirst : List ℕ
  /-- `b_s` for each small cell. -/
  smallB : List SNat
  /-- `ξ`, the per-action error. -/
  ξ : SRat
  /-- `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`. -/
  kAcc : ℕ
  /-- `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`, sealed. -/
  kAccS : SNat

/-- The type of a state: a transversal, the defect class `A_il`, or outside
`X`. -/
noncomputable def get (x : SNat) : ℕ := x.raw

/-- A constant or an input number, at the price of its length. -/
noncomputable def pSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((smallCells I ε δ).map fun e => e.2.2).sum

/-- Large cells by decreasing bound, ties in retained order: each cell is
inserted before the first one of strictly smaller bound. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def pairCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (nSmall I ε δ)).flatMap fun s => List.replicate (smallB I ε δ s) s

/-- `s(i)`, the small cell of pair `i`. -/
noncomputable def cellFirst (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range s, smallB I ε δ t

/-- `q = W²`. -/
noncomputable def smallB (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ := (smallAt I ε δ s).2.2

/-- The small cell of each pair label: cell `s` owns `b_s` consecutive labels. -/
noncomputable def ξParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ηParam I ε δ / ((1000 * JstarParam I ε δ : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-- `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`, the bits of one acceptance threshold. -/
noncomputable def kAccParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.clog 2 ⌈(ξParam I ε δ)⁻¹⌉₊

/-- The initial multipliers `w^(0)` for `i ≠ l`: `6` if `s(i) = s(l)`, else
`6 (b_{s(i)} + 1) / (b_{s(l)} + 2)`; `0` on the diagonal and outside `p × p`. -/
def mu0 (K : Chain) (tape : Coins ℕ) (cur : ℕ) : Prog (List Bool × ℕ) := do
  let S0 ← Operations.replicate (2 * K.p) false
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let zero ← SNat.lit 0
  Charged.repeatFor (fun s (st : List Bool × ℕ) => do
    let b ← Operations.get K.smallB s
    let first ← Operations.get K.cellFirst s
    let b1 ← SNat.add b one
    let (k, cur1) ← dyadicDraw tape b1 K.ξ st.2
    let cnt ← binom b k
    let (rank, cur2) ← dyadicDraw tape cnt K.ξ cur1
    let bI ← SNat.index b
    let st' ← Charged.repeatFor (fun t (st' : List Bool × SNat × SNat) => do
      let lbl := first + t
      let remaining ← SNat.lt zero st'.2.1
      if remaining then do
        let tS ← SNat.lit (t + 1)
        let rest ← SNat.sub b tS
        let k1 ← SNat.sub st'.2.1 one
        let c ← binom rest k1
        let incl ← SNat.lt st'.2.2 c
        if incl then do
          let S ← Operations.set st'.1 (2 * lbl) true
          pure (S, k1, st'.2.2)
        else do
          let r ← SNat.sub st'.2.2 c
          let S ← Operations.set st'.1 (2 * lbl + 1) true
          pure (S, st'.2.1, r)
      else do
        let S ← Operations.set st'.1 (2 * lbl + 1) true
        pure (S, st'.2.1, st'.2.2)) bI (st.1, k, rank)
    pure (st'.1, cur2)) K.nsm (S0, cur)

/-! ## S9: one phase of the annealing run -/

/-- The phase parameters of `eq:alg-phase-parameters`. -/
noncomputable def tapeHeads : ℕ → PMF (Finset ℕ)
  | 0 => PMF.pure ∅
  | T + 1 => (tapeHeads T).bind fun s =>
      ProbRAM.fair.bind fun b => PMF.pure (if b then insert T s else s)

/-- `T` independent fair bits at positions `0..T-1` (tails beyond), as the
program's sealed coin family. -/
abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/
def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/
structure SNat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℕ

/-- **A sealed rational number.** -/
noncomputable def pairCell (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (i : ℕ) : ℕ := (pairCells I ε δ).getD i 0

/-- The first pair label of small cell `s`. -/
structure SRat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℚ

namespace SNat

/-- The number held.  **Specification-only.** -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def smallAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry :=
  (smallCells I ε δ).getD k (0, 0, 0)

/-- The `k`-th free cell. -/
noncomputable def ηParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ε / ((200 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-- `τ = 2 K_obs (H + p + K + 5)`. -/
noncomputable def JstarParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  100 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) *
    (BretParam I ε δ + NavParam I ε δ + pSmall I ε δ + dParam I + 1)

/-- `ξ = η / (1000 J_*)`. -/
noncomputable def tape (T : ℕ) : PMF (Coins ℕ) :=
  (tapeHeads T).map Coins.ofFinset

/-- **The tape length**: the most fair bits any execution of the algorithm on
`(I, ε, δ)` reads. -/
abbrev Prog := Charged Operations.Op Operations.Cell

/-- A cell of a (tightened) table: row, column, and its bound. -/
def dyadicDraw (tape : Coins ℕ) (M : SNat) (ζ : SRat) (cur : ℕ) : Prog (SNat × ℕ) := do
  let Mq ← SNat.toRat M
  let q ← SRat.div Mq ζ
  let c ← SRat.natCeil q
  let k ← clog2 c
  let kI ← SNat.index k
  let (Y, cur') ← uniformBits tape kI cur
  let MY ← SNat.mul M Y
  let pk ← SNat.pow2 k
  let out ← SNat.div MY pk
  pure (out, cur')

/-! ## S0: reading the input and its length -/

/-- Read a list of input naturals into sealed numbers. -/
def binom (n k : SNat) : Prog SNat := do
  let kI ← SNat.index k
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let nk ← SNat.sub n k
  Charged.repeatFor (fun i acc => do
    let iS ← SNat.lit (i + 1)
    let num ← SNat.add nk iS
    let t ← SNat.mul acc num
    SNat.div t iS) kI one

/-- **A fresh `μ₀` draw**: per small cell, `k_s` uniform in `{0..b_s}` and a
uniform `k_s`-subset of its `b_s` pairs (a dyadic draw of a rank in
`[0, C(b_s, k_s))`, decoded by lexicographic binomial unranking); those pairs use
their row element, the rest their column element. -/
def phase (C : Ctx) (K : Chain) (tape : Coins ℕ) (Ph : Phase) (j : ℕ) (st : Run) :
    Prog Run := do
  if st.aborted then pure st else do
    let (S0, cur1) ← mu0 K tape st.cur
    let rs ← restart C K tape Ph st.ws j S0 cur1
    if rs.aborted then pure ⟨st.ws, st.prod, true, rs.cur⟩ else do
      let w ← Operations.get st.ws j
      let o ← observe C K tape Ph j w rs.S rs.cur
      let pos ← allPositive K o
      if pos then do
        let Nq ← SNat.toRat Ph.Nav
        let u ← SRat.div o.sumG Nq
        let n0q ← SNat.toRat o.n0
        let p0 ← SRat.div n0q Nq
        let R ← SRat.div u p0
        let prod ← SRat.mul st.prod R
        let more ← idxLt (j + 1) Ph.Hn
        if more then do
          let w' ← updateW K w o
          let ws ← Operations.push st.ws w'
          pure ⟨ws, prod, false, o.cur⟩
        else pure ⟨st.ws, prod, false, o.cur⟩
      else pure ⟨st.ws, st.prod, true, o.cur⟩

/-- **S11, one annealing run** (`p ≥ 1`): phases `j = 0..H-1`; output
`C(0) ∏_j R̂_j`, or zero after an abort. -/
noncomputable def run (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    PMF (Charged Model.Operations.Op Model.Operations.Cell ℚ) :=
  (tape (tapeLength I ε δ)).map (Program.fpras I ε δ)

/-- **The output distribution**: the law of the estimate `Ẑ`. -/
def eq (x y : SNat) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen x.raw + bitLen y.raw) (decide (x.raw = y.raw))

one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
structure Ctx where
  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Tightened row margins. -/

  /-- Tightened column margins. -/

  d : SNat

  Hq : SRat
  /-- `B` as a rational. -/

/-- **S4**: the small/large split, the forest, roots, elimination order and
`M_f`. -/
noncomputable def get (x : SNat) : ℕ := x.raw

/-- A constant or an input number, at the price of its length. -/
abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × SNat

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/
noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/
noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/
noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/
noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/
noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/
noncomputable def elimOrder (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  let T := (forest I ε δ).tree
  ((List.range (I.m + I.n)).foldl (fun st k =>
    match st.2.1[k]? with
    | none => st
    | some u => (List.range T.length).foldl (fun st' t =>
        let e := T.getD t (0, 0, 0)
        if e.1 = u then visit (I.m + e.2.1) t st'
        else if I.m + e.2.1 = u then visit e.1 t st' else st') st)
    ((roots I ε δ).toFinset, roots I ε δ, [])).2.2

/-- `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. -/
noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (I.m + I.n)).filter fun v =>
    decide (∀ u < v, (forest I ε δ).comp u ≠ (forest I ε δ).comp v)

/-- Breadth-first discovery of `w` through tree edge `t`: visited set, queue,
and the discovered `(vertex, parent edge)` pairs, newest first. -/
noncomputable def Mf (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((forest I ε δ).free.map fun e => e.2.2 + 1).prod

/-! ## S5: the penalty `D(x, y, z)` (`eq:penalty`, `scales.tex:113-126`) -/

/-- Number of small cells. -/
noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ := I.m * I.n + I.m + I.n + 2

/-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. -/
noncomputable def BParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 16 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2

/-- `W = 100 d B`. -/
noncomputable def HParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  10 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2 * (WParam I ε δ + 1)

/-! ## S4: small and large cells, the maximum spanning forest -/

/-- Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. -/
noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=

  /-- The first pair label of each small cell. -/
  cellFirst : List ℕ
  /-- `b_s` for each small cell. -/
  smallB : List SNat
  /-- `ξ`, the per-action error. -/
  ξ : SRat

  let one ← SNat.lit 1

    if st.finished then pure st else
    if st.aborted then pure st else do
      let full ← SNat.le Ph.Bret st.used

        let w ← Operations.get ws st.stage

        let used ← SNat.add st.used one

        | .transversal => do
          let hits ← SNat.add st.hits one
          let stageDone ← SNat.eq hits Ph.τ
          if stageDone then do
            let last ← idxEq st.stage j

          else pure ⟨S', st.stage, hits, used, false, false, cur'⟩
        | _ => pure ⟨S', st.stage, st.hits, used, false, false, cur'⟩)

one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/
structure Ctx where
