    pure (some (res', bn))

/-- The maximum-flow value, by at most `V³` Edmonds–Karp augmentations (their
`O(VE)` bound is a proof obligation). -/

queries.subject: oracle
queries.text:
oracle def oracle (C : Ctx) (tape : Coins ℕ) (x y : List SNat) (j : ℕ) (ξin θ : SRat)
    (cur : ℕ) : Prog (SRat × ℕ) *The weight oracle** `ĥ_j(x, y)`: `M_f · ∏_{a<j} R̂_a · T̂`, every call on fresh bits. def oracle (C : Ctx) (tape : Coins ℕ) (x y : List SNat) (j : ℕ) (ξin θ : SRat)
    (cur : ℕ) : Prog (SRat × ℕ) := do
  let P ← oracleParams C ξin θ
  let one ← SRat.lit 1
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun a (st : SRat × ℕ) => do
    let (r, cur') ← ratioAvg C P tape x y a st.2
    let p ← SRat.mul st.1 r
    pure (p, cur')) j (one, cur)
  let (T, cur') ← corrAvg C P tape x y j st.2
  let Mq ← SNat.toRat C.Mf
  let t ← SRat.mul Mq st.1
  let out ← SRat.mul t T
  pure (out, cur')

/-! ## S8-S10: the paired state space and the implemented Metropolis chain -/

/-- What the chain needs about the small cells: `p`, the cell of each pair
label, the first label of each cell, the small bounds, `ξ`, and the acceptance
bit count `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`. -/

queries.subject: cellMax
queries.text:
cellMax def cellMax (m n : ℕ) (r c : List SNat) (b : List (List SNat)) (i j : ℕ) (lo : SNat) :
    Prog SNat `u_ij`, the greatest feasible value of cell `(i, j)`, searched in `[l_ij, b_ij]`. def cellMax (m n : ℕ) (r c : List SNat) (b : List (List SNat)) (i j : ℕ) (lo : SNat) :
    Prog SNat := do
  let bij ← get2 b i j
  let k ← searchRounds bij
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ (st : SNat × SNat) => do
    let isOpen ← SNat.lt st.1 st.2
    if isOpen then do
      let one ← SNat.lit 1
      let s ← SNat.add st.1 st.2
      let s1 ← SNat.add s one
      let mid ← half s1
      let ok ← feasibleAtLeast m n r c b i j mid
      if ok then pure (mid, st.2) else do
        let hi' ← SNat.sub mid one
        pure (st.1, hi')
    else pure st) k (lo, bij)
  pure st.1

/-- The tightened instance (`scales.tex:24-44`): margins with all incident
minima subtracted, and the retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive
bound.  All row and column vertices are retained. -/

queries.subject: buildCtx
queries.text:
buildCtx def buildCtx (m n : ℕ) (T : Tight) (Pm : Params) : Prog Ctx *S4**: the small/large split, the forest, roots, elimination order and `M_f`. def buildCtx (m n : ℕ) (T : Tight) (Pm : Params) : Prog Ctx := do
  let ((small, nSmall), (large, _)) ← splitCells Pm.W T.cells
  let sorted ← sortDesc large
  let ((tree, nTree), (free, nFree), comp) ← kruskal m n sorted
  let rts ← rootsOf (m + n) comp
  let order ← orient m n tree nTree rts
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let Mf ← Charged.foldl (fun acc (e : Entry) => do
    let b1 ← SNat.add e.2.2 one
    SNat.mul acc b1) free one
  let Aq ← SNat.toRat Pm.A
  let Hq ← SNat.toRat Pm.H
  let Bq ← SNat.toRat Pm.B
  pure ⟨m, n, T.rows, T.cols, small, nSmall, free, nFree, tree, nTree, order, rts, Mf,
    Pm.d, Pm.B, Pm.H, Aq, Hq, Bq⟩

/-! ## S5: the penalty `D(x, y, z)` (`eq:penalty`) -/

/-- Add `x` to entry `v` of a vector. -/

queries.subject: splitCells
queries.text:
splitCells def splitCells (W : SNat) (cells : List Entry) :
    Prog ((List Entry × ℕ) × (List Entry × ℕ)) Split retained cells into small (`b < W`) and large ones, with their counts. def splitCells (W : SNat) (cells : List Entry) :
    Prog ((List Entry × ℕ) × (List Entry × ℕ)) :=
  Charged.foldl (fun (st : (List Entry × ℕ) × (List Entry × ℕ)) (e : Entry) => do
    let isSmall ← SNat.lt e.2.2 W
    if isSmall then do
      let s ← Operations.push st.1.1 e
      pure ((s, st.1.2 + 1), st.2)
    else do
      let l ← Operations.push st.2.1 e
      pure (st.1, (l, st.2.2 + 1))) cells (([], 0), ([], 0))

/-- Insert `x` into a list sorted by decreasing bound, after every entry whose
bound is at least `x`'s. -/

queries.subject: insertAsc
queries.text:
insertAsc def insertAsc (l : List SRat) (x : SRat) : Prog (List SRat) Insert `x` into an ascending list, after every entry not greater than it. def insertAsc (l : List SRat) (x : SRat) : Prog (List SRat) := do
  let st ← Charged.foldl (fun (st : List SRat × Bool) (y : SRat) => do
    if st.2 then do
      let o ← Operations.push st.1 y
      pure (o, true)
    else do
      let before ← SRat.lt x y
      if before then do
        let o ← Operations.push st.1 x
        let o' ← Operations.push o y
        pure (o', true)
      else do
        let o ← Operations.push st.1 y
        pure (o, false)) l ([], false)
  if st.2 then pure st.1 else Operations.push st.1 x

/-- The order statistic at position `idx` (from `0`). -/

queries.subject: OParams
queries.text:
OParams structure OParams where /-- `N_in`, samples per average. -/ The internal parameters of one oracle call (`evaluation.tex:327-354`). structure OParams where
  /-- `N_in`, samples per average. -/
  N : ℕ
  /-- `N_in` as a rational. -/
  Nq : SRat
  /-- `ℓ_in`, steps of each bin walk. -/
  ell : ℕ
  /-- `⌈log₂ (4d)⌉`, bits per walk proposal. -/
  kd : ℕ
  /-- `2e`, the number of signed coordinate directions. -/
  twoE : SNat
  /-- `B - 1`, the last bin index. -/
  Bm1 : SNat
  /-- `ζ = θ/(8 Q_in)`, the offset-draw tolerance. -/
  ζ : SRat
  /-- `log₂ s'`. -/
  ks : ℕ
  /-- `s'`, the power of two in `[32/σ, 64/σ]`. -/
  sPrime : SNat
  /-- `⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉`, the bisection depth. -/
  depth : ℕ
  /-- `B^e`. -/
  Be : SNat

/-- `σ, N_in, Q_in, K_bin, ℓ_in, s', depth, ζ` from `ξ_in` and `θ`. -/

queries.subject: bottleneck
queries.text:
bottleneck def bottleneck (V : ℕ) (res : List (List SNat)) (par : List (Option ℕ)) :
    Prog SNat The bottleneck residual capacity along the parent path from the sink. def bottleneck (V : ℕ) (res : List (List SNat)) (par : List (Option ℕ)) :
    Prog SNat := do
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ (st : ℕ × Option SNat) => do
    let atSrc ← idxEq st.1 0
    if atSrc then pure st else do
      let pu ← Operations.get par st.1
      match pu with
      | none => pure st
      | some u => do
        let cuv ← get2 res u st.1
        match st.2 with
        | none => pure (u, some cuv)
        | some bn => do
          let smaller ← SNat.lt cuv bn
          if smaller then pure (u, some cuv) else pure (u, some bn)) V (V - 1, none)
  match st.2 with
  | none => SNat.lit 0
  | some bn => pure bn

/-- Push `bn` units along the parent path from the sink. -/

queries.subject: searchRounds
queries.text:
searchRounds def searchRounds (x : SNat) : Prog ℕ Rounds of a binary search over `[0, x]`: `bitLen x ≥ ⌈log₂ (x + 1)⌉`. def searchRounds (x : SNat) : Prog ℕ := do
  let len ← SNat.bitLen x
  SNat.index len

/-- `l_ij`, the least feasible value of cell `(i, j)`: binary search for the
least `v ≤ b_ij` such that the instance with `b_ij := v` is feasible. -/

queries.subject: coin
queries.text:
coin def coin (tape : Coins ℕ) (cur : ℕ) : Prog (Bool × ℕ) One fair bit, read from the tape at the cursor; the cursor advances. def coin (tape : Coins ℕ) (cur : ℕ) : Prog (Bool × ℕ) := do
  let b ← Coins.flip cur tape
  pure (b, cur + 1)

/-- `k` fair bits, read as the binary integer `Y ∈ [0, 2^k)`. -/

queries.subject: sortDesc
queries.text:
sortDesc def sortDesc (l : List Entry) : Prog (List Entry) Large cells sorted by decreasing capacity (insertion sort, stable). def sortDesc (l : List Entry) : Prog (List Entry) :=
  Charged.foldl (fun acc x => insertDesc acc x) l []

/-- Kruskal's construction (`scales.tex:91-99`) on the bipartite graph with
vertices `0..m-1` (rows) and `m..m+n-1` (columns): add a large cell, in order
of decreasing capacity, whenever it joins two current components.  Returns the
tree cells, the free cells (with counts) and the final component labels. -/

queries.subject: binom
queries.text:
binom def binom (n k : SNat) : Prog SNat `C(n, k)`, as `∏_{i=1}^{k} (n - k + i)/i`, exact at every prefix. def binom (n k : SNat) : Prog SNat := do
  let kI ← SNat.index k
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let nk ← SNat.sub n k
  Charged.repeatFor (fun i acc => do
    let iS ← SNat.lit (i + 1)
    let num ← SNat.add nk iS
    let t ← SNat.mul acc num
    SNat.div t iS) kI one

/-- **A fresh `μ₀` draw**: per small cell, `k_s` uniform in `{0..b_s}` and a
uniform `k_s`-subset of its `b_s` pairs (a dyadic draw of a rank in
`[0, C(b_s, k_s))`, decoded by lexicographic binomial unranking); those pairs use
their row element, the rest their column element. -/

queries.subject: oracleParams
queries.text:
oracleParams def oracleParams (C : Ctx) (ξin θ : SRat) : Prog OParams `σ, N_in, Q_in, K_bin, ℓ_in, s', depth, ζ` from `ξ_in` and `θ`. def oracleParams (C : Ctx) (ξin θ : SRat) : Prog OParams := do
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let H1 ← SNat.add C.H one
  let H1q ← SNat.toRat H1
  -- σ = ξ_in / (50 (H + 1))
  let c50 ← SRat.lit 50
  let den ← SRat.mul c50 H1q
  let σ ← SRat.div ξin den
  -- N_in = ⌈10⁶ (H + 1) / (θ σ²)⌉
  let c1e6 ← SRat.lit 1000000
  let num ← SRat.mul c1e6 H1q
  let σ2 ← SRat.mul σ σ
  let θσ2 ← SRat.mul θ σ2
  let nq ← SRat.div num θσ2
  let N ← SRat.natCeil nq
  let NI ← SNat.index N
  let Nq ← SNat.toRat N
  -- Q_in = (d + 1)(H + 1) N_in
  let d1 ← SNat.add C.d one
  let dH ← SNat.mul d1 H1
  let Q ← SNat.mul dH N
  let Qq ← SNat.toRat Q
  -- K_bin = 2 (10⁴ d² B)²
  let d2 ← SNat.mul C.d C.d
  let c1e4 ← SNat.lit 10000
  let t ← SNat.mul c1e4 d2
  let t' ← SNat.mul t C.B
  let t2 ← SNat.mul t' t'
  let two ← SNat.lit 2
  let Kbin ← SNat.mul two t2
  -- ℓ_in = ⌈K_bin (H + dB + 16 Q_in/θ + 2)⌉
  let dB ← SNat.mul C.d C.B
  let s ← SNat.add C.H dB
  let s2 ← SNat.add s two
  let s2q ← SNat.toRat s2
  let c16 ← SRat.lit 16
  let q16 ← SRat.mul c16 Qq
  let q16θ ← SRat.div q16 θ
  let inner ← SRat.add s2q q16θ
  let Kq ← SNat.toRat Kbin
  let ellq ← SRat.mul Kq inner
  let ellN ← SRat.natCeil ellq
  let ell ← SNat.index ellN
  -- ⌈log₂ (4d)⌉
  let c4 ← SNat.lit 4
  let d4 ← SNat.mul c4 C.d
  let kdN ← clog2 d4
  let kd ← SNat.index kdN
  -- 2e and B - 1
  let eS ← SNat.lit C.nFree
  let twoE ← SNat.mul two eS
  let Bm1 ← SNat.sub C.B one
  -- ζ = θ / (8 Q_in)
  let c8 ← SRat.lit 8
  let q8 ← SRat.mul c8 Qq
  let ζ ← SRat.div θ q8
  -- s' = 2^⌈log₂ ⌈32/σ⌉⌉, the power of two in [32/σ, 64/σ]
  let c32 ← SRat.lit 32
  let r32 ← SRat.div c32 σ
  let c32N ← SRat.natCeil r32
  let ksN ← clog2 c32N
  let ks ← SNat.index ksN
  let sPrime ← SNat.pow2 ksN
  -- depth = ⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉
  let c512 ← SRat.lit 512
  let r512 ← SRat.div c512 σ
  let c512N ← SRat.natCeil r512
  let depN ← clog2 c512N
  let depth ← SNat.index depN
  -- B^e
  let Be ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ acc => SNat.mul acc C.B) C.nFree one
  pure ⟨NI, Nq, ell, kd, twoE, Bm1, ζ, ks, sPrime, depth, Be⟩

/-- `⌊a·D/H⌋`, the exponent with `V_a = 2^{-⌊a D/H⌋}`. -/

queries.subject: clog2
queries.text:
clog2 def clog2 (x : SNat) : Prog SNat `⌈log₂ x⌉ = Nat.clog 2 x`, computed as `Nat.size (x - 1)`. def clog2 (x : SNat) : Prog SNat := do
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let y ← SNat.sub x one
  SNat.size y

/-- `⌈a / b⌉` for `b ≥ 1`. -/

queries.subject: Entry
queries.text:
Entry abbrev Entry A cell of a (tightened) table: row, column, and its bound. abbrev Entry := ℕ × ℕ × SNat

/-! ## Arithmetic and addressing helpers -/

/-- `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. -/

queries.subject: uniformBits
queries.text:
uniformBits def uniformBits (tape : Coins ℕ) (k : ℕ) (cur : ℕ) : Prog (SNat × ℕ) `k` fair bits, read as the binary integer `Y ∈ [0, 2^k)`. def uniformBits (tape : Coins ℕ) (k : ℕ) (cur : ℕ) : Prog (SNat × ℕ) := do
  let z ← SNat.lit 0
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let two ← SNat.lit 2
  Charged.repeatFor (fun _ (st : SNat × ℕ) => do
    let (bit, cur') ← coin tape st.2
    let y2 ← SNat.mul st.1 two
    if bit then do
      let y ← SNat.add y2 one
      pure (y, cur')
    else pure (y2, cur')) k (z, cur)

/-- **`lem:dyadic-integer-draw`** (`evaluation.tex:356-371`): for `M ≥ 1` and
`0 < ζ < 1`, let `k` be the least natural with `M·2^{-k} ≤ ζ`, draw `Y` uniform on
`[0, 2^k)` with `k` fair bits, and output `⌊M·Y/2^k⌋`.  The least such `k` is
`⌈log₂ ⌈M/ζ⌉⌉`. -/

queries.subject: Params
queries.text:
Params structure Params where /-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/ The parameters of `eq:parameters` (`scales.tex:48-56`). structure Params where
  /-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/
  d : SNat
  /-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`. -/
  K : SNat
  /-- `A = ⌈4K/γ⌉` with `γ = ε/(512 d K)`. -/
  A : SNat
  /-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/
  B : SNat
  /-- `W = 100 d B`. -/
  W : SNat
  /-- `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. -/
  H : SNat

/-- **S3**: exact computation of `d, K, γ, A, B, W, H`. -/

queries.subject: Prog
queries.text:
Prog abbrev Prog A charged computation in the bit-operation currency. abbrev Prog := Charged Operations.Op Operations.Cell

/-- A cell of a (tightened) table: row, column, and its bound. -/

queries.subject: pushFlow
queries.text:
pushFlow def pushFlow (V : ℕ) (res : List (List SNat)) (par : List (Option ℕ)) (bn : SNat) :
    Prog (List (List SNat)) Push `bn` units along the parent path from the sink. def pushFlow (V : ℕ) (res : List (List SNat)) (par : List (Option ℕ)) (bn : SNat) :
    Prog (List (List SNat)) := do
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun _ (st : ℕ × List (List SNat)) => do
    let atSrc ← idxEq st.1 0
    if atSrc then pure st else do
      let pu ← Operations.get par st.1
      match pu with
      | none => pure st
      | some u => do
        let fwd ← get2 st.2 u st.1
        let fwd' ← SNat.sub fwd bn
        let res1 ← set2 st.2 u st.1 fwd'
        let bwd ← get2 res1 st.1 u
        let bwd' ← SNat.add bwd bn
        let res2 ← set2 res1 st.1 u bwd'
        pure (u, res2)) V (V - 1, res)
  pure st.2

/-- One Edmonds–Karp augmentation along a shortest residual path; `none` when
the sink is unreachable. -/

queries.subject: params
queries.text:
params def params (m n : ℕ) (L : SNat) (ε : SRat) : Prog Params *S3**: exact computation of `d, K, γ, A, B, W, H`. def params (m n : ℕ) (L : SNat) (ε : SRat) : Prog Params := do
  let mS ← SNat.lit m
  let nS ← SNat.lit n
  let mn ← SNat.mul mS nS
  let t1 ← SNat.add mn mS
  let t2 ← SNat.add t1 nS
  let two ← SNat.lit 2
  let d ← SNat.add t2 two
  let oneQ ← SRat.lit 1
  let inv ← SRat.div oneQ ε
  let ce ← SRat.natCeil inv
  let lg ← clog2 ce
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let s1 ← SNat.add L d
  let s2 ← SNat.add s1 lg
  let s3 ← SNat.add s2 one
  let c20 ← SNat.lit 20
  let K ← SNat.mul c20 s3
  let c512 ← SNat.lit 512
  let dK ← SNat.mul d K
  let den ← SNat.mul c512 dK
  let denQ ← SNat.toRat den
  let γ ← SRat.div ε denQ
  let c4 ← SNat.lit 4
  let fK ← SNat.mul c4 K
  let fKq ← SNat.toRat fK
  let q ← SRat.div fKq γ
  let A ← SRat.natCeil q
  let d2 ← SNat.mul d d
  let c16 ← SNat.lit 16
  let a16 ← SNat.mul c16 A
  let B ← SNat.mul a16 d2
  let c100 ← SNat.lit 100
  let d100 ← SNat.mul c100 d
  let W ← SNat.mul d100 B
  let c10 ← SNat.lit 10
  let a10 ← SNat.mul c10 A
  let ad2 ← SNat.mul a10 d2
  let W1 ← SNat.add W one
  let H ← SNat.mul ad2 W1
  pure ⟨d, K, A, B, W, H⟩

/-! ## S4: small and large cells, the maximum spanning forest -/

/-- Split retained cells into small (`b < W`) and large ones, with their
counts. -/

queries.subject: Phase
queries.text:
Phase structure Phase where /-- `τ`, trace steps per stage. -/ The phase parameters of `eq:alg-phase-parameters`. structure Phase where
  /-- `τ`, trace steps per stage. -/
  τ : SNat
  /-- `B_ret`, the restart transition cap. -/
  Bret : SNat
  /-- `B_ret`, as a loop count. -/
  BretN : ℕ
  /-- `N_av`, observed states per phase. -/
  Nav : SNat
  /-- `N_av`, as a loop count. -/
  NavN : ℕ
  /-- `H`, as a loop count. -/
  Hn : ℕ

/-- The restart of one phase: the current state, the stage `a`, trace steps done
in it, transitions used, and whether it finished or aborted. -/

queries.subject: readList
queries.text:
readList def readList (l : List ℕ) : Prog (List SNat) Read a list of input naturals into sealed numbers. def readList (l : List ℕ) : Prog (List SNat) :=
  Charged.foldl (fun acc k => do
    let x ← SNat.lit k
    Operations.push acc x) l []

/-- Read a matrix of input naturals. -/

queries.subject: orderStat
queries.text:
orderStat def orderStat (outs : List SRat) (idx : ℕ) : Prog SRat The order statistic at position `idx` (from `0`). def orderStat (outs : List SRat) (idx : ℕ) : Prog SRat := do
  let sorted ← Charged.foldl (fun acc x => insertAsc acc x) outs []
  Operations.get sorted idx

/-! ## The algorithm -/

/-- **The paper's algorithm** (Theorem `thm:main`), run on the instance `I` and
the accuracy parameters `ε, δ`, reading fair bits from `tape` from position `0`
on.

S0 reads the input and computes `L`.  S1 tests feasibility (equal totals, then
maximum flow); an infeasible input returns `0` without reading a coin.  S2–S4
tighten the instance, compute `eq:parameters`, and build the forest, once.
`s = ⌈log₂ δ⁻¹⌉` and `R = 10 s + 1`.  The `p = 0` / `p ≥ 1` dispatch is decided
once, before any `p`-dependent parameter.  Then `R` independent runs on
consecutive stretches of the tape, and their median, the order statistic at
`5 s = (R - 1)/2`. -/

queries.subject: rootsOf
queries.text:
rootsOf def rootsOf (V : ℕ) (comp : List ℕ) : Prog (List ℕ) One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. def rootsOf (V : ℕ) (comp : List ℕ) : Prog (List ℕ) := do
  let seen0 ← Operations.replicate V false
  let st ← Charged.repeatFor (fun v (st : List Bool × List ℕ) => do
    let cv ← Operations.get comp v
    let s ← Operations.get st.1 cv
    if s then pure st else do
      let seen ← Operations.set st.1 cv true
      let rs ← Operations.push st.2 v
      pure (seen, rs)) V (seen0, [])
  pure st.2

/-- Breadth-first search state over the forest: visited marks, the queue, its
length, and the discovered `(vertex, parent tree edge)` pairs, newest first. -/

queries.subject: set2
queries.text:
set2 def set2 {α : Type} (M : List (List α)) (u v : ℕ) (a : α) : Prog (List (List α)) Overwrite entry `(u, v)` of a matrix. def set2 {α : Type} (M : List (List α)) (u v : ℕ) (a : α) : Prog (List (List α)) := do
  let row ← Operations.get M u
  let row' ← Operations.set row v a
  Operations.set M u row'

/-! ## Fair bits and the dyadic integer draw -/

/-- One fair bit, read from the tape at the cursor; the cursor advances. -/

queries.subject: subLists
queries.text:
subLists def subLists (a b : List SNat) (k : ℕ) : Prog (List SNat) Entrywise `a_i - b_i` for `i < k`. def subLists (a b : List SNat) (k : ℕ) : Prog (List SNat) :=
  Charged.repeatFor (fun i acc => do
    let x ← Operations.get a i
    let y ← Operations.get b i
    let d ← SNat.sub x y
    Operations.push acc d) k []

/-- **S2**: the extrema `l_ij`, `u_ij` of every cell, by binary search with
flow feasibility, and the tightened instance. -/

queries.subject: addAt
queries.text:
addAt def addAt (acc : List SRat) (v : ℕ) (x : SRat) : Prog (List SRat) Add `x` to entry `v` of a vector. def addAt (acc : List SRat) (v : ℕ) (x : SRat) : Prog (List SRat) := do
  let a ← Operations.get acc v
  let a' ← SRat.add a x
  Operations.set acc v a'

/-- The prescribed (tightened) margin of vertex `v`. -/

queries.subject: sumN
queries.text:
sumN def sumN (l : List SNat) : Prog SNat `Σ` of a list of sealed naturals. def sumN (l : List SNat) : Prog SNat := do
  let z ← SNat.lit 0
  Charged.foldl (fun acc x => SNat.add acc x) l z

/-- `⌈log₂ x⌉ = Nat.clog 2 x`, computed as `Nat.size (x - 1)`. -/

queries.subject: readMatrix
queries.text:
readMatrix def readMatrix (rows : List (List ℕ)) : Prog (List (List SNat)) Read a matrix of input naturals. def readMatrix (rows : List (List ℕ)) : Prog (List (List SNat)) :=
  Charged.foldl (fun acc row => do
    let xs ← readList row
    Operations.push acc xs) rows []

/-- **S0**: the input length `L`.  It is read through the charged primitive
`SNat.inputLength`, whose value is `Prelude`'s `inputLength I ε δ` itself, the
quantity the cost conjunct of the theorem is stated in.  `L` is not re-derived
here (restatement caller guard "shared-inputLength-contract"). -/

queries.subject: ceilDivN
queries.text:
ceilDivN def ceilDivN (a b : SNat) : Prog SNat `⌈a / b⌉` for `b ≥ 1`. def ceilDivN (a b : SNat) : Prog SNat := do
  let one ← SNat.lit 1
  let s ← SNat.add a b
  let s' ← SNat.sub s one
  SNat.div s' b

/-- `⌊x / 2⌋`. -/

queries.subject: distQ
queries.text:
distQ def distQ (x b : SRat) : Prog SRat `dist(x, [0, b])`. def distQ (x b : SRat) : Prog SRat := do
  let z ← SRat.lit 0
  let neg ← SRat.lt x z
  if neg then SRat.sub z x else do
    let over ← SRat.lt b x
    if over then SRat.sub x b else pure z

/-- **`D(x, y, z)`** (`scales.tex:113-126`).  The small cells contribute `x_s` to
their row and `b_s - y_s` to their column; the free cells contribute `z_e` to
both endpoints; leaf elimination then solves each tree value from the margin of
its nonroot endpoint; finally
`D = A (Σ_roots |δ_v| + Σ_{t ∈ T} dist(z_t, [0, b_t]) / b_t)`. -/

queries.subject: half
queries.text:
half def half (x : SNat) : Prog SNat `⌊x / 2⌋`. def half (x : SNat) : Prog SNat := do
  let two ← SNat.lit 2
  SNat.div x two

/-- Read entry `(u, v)` of a matrix. -/

queries.subject: absQ
queries.text:
absQ def absQ (x : SRat) : Prog SRat `|x|`. def absQ (x : SRat) : Prog SRat := do
  let z ← SRat.lit 0
  let neg ← SRat.lt x z
  if neg then SRat.sub z x else pure x

/-- `dist(x, [0, b])`. -/

queries.subject: fpras
queries.text:
fpras noncomputable def fpras (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF ℚ *The paper's algorithm** (`thm:main`, proof at `algorithm.tex:607-707`): the law of `Ẑ`. Infeasible inputs give `0` with no draw. Otherwise `s = ⌈log₂ δ⁻¹⌉`, `R = 10 s + 1` independent single runs (`p = 0`: `zeroRun`; `p ≥ 1`: `annealRun`) and their median, the order statistic at `5 s`. noncomputable def fpras (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF ℚ :=
  if feasible I then
    (repeatRuns (10 * sRep δ + 1)
        (if pSmall I ε δ = 0 then zeroRun I ε δ else annealRun I ε δ)).map
      fun outs => orderStat outs (5 * sRep δ)
  else PMF.pure 0

end Cellcounting.Pseudocode

queries.subject: mu0
Instance
queries.text:
Instance structure Instance where /-- Number of rows. -/ An input `(m, n, r, c, b)`: dimensions, row margins, column margins and cell bounds, all natural numbers given in binary. The paper's `m, n ≥ 1` is a hypothesis of the theorem, not a field; the equal-totals condition is neither. structure Instance where
  /-- Number of rows. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Number of columns. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- Row margins `r_i`. -/
  r : Fin m → ℕ
  /-- Column margins `c_j`. -/
  c : Fin n → ℕ
  /-- Cell upper bounds `b_ij`; zero is allowed. -/
  b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus
one, so that `0` costs one bit. -/

queries.subject: treeValues
queries.text:
treeValues noncomputable def treeValues (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) :
    (ℕ → ℚ) × (ℕ → ℚ) Leaf elimination: along `elimOrder`, the tree value of a nonroot vertex's parent edge is its margin minus its current load, which is then added to the parent. Returns the final loads and the tree values `z_t`. noncomputable def treeValues (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) :
    (ℕ → ℚ) × (ℕ → ℚ) :=
  (elimOrder I ε δ).foldl (fun st vt =>
    let e := treeAt I ε δ vt.2
    let ztv := margin I vt.1 - st.1 vt.1
    let other := if vt.1 = e.1 then I.m + e.2.1 else e.1
    (Function.update st.1 other (st.1 other + ztv), Function.update st.2 vt.2 ztv))
    (baseLoad I ε δ x y z, fun _ => 0)

/-- `dist(x, [0, b])`. -/

queries.subject: restartStep
queries.text:
restartStep noncomputable def restartStep (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (st : Restart) : PMF Restart One iteration of the capped restart of phase `j`: stop if finished or aborted; abort if `B_ret` transitions are used; otherwise one transition of `P_{a, w^(a)}`, and a trace step ends at a transversal. noncomputable def restartStep (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (st : Restart) : PMF Restart :=
  if st.finished then pure st else if st.aborted then pure st else
  if BretParam I ε δ ≤ st.used then pure { st with aborted := true } else do
    let S' ← step I ε δ st.stage (ws st.stage) st.S
    match kind I ε δ S' with
    | .transversal =>
      if st.hits + 1 = τParam I ε δ then
        pure ⟨S', st.stage + 1, 0, st.used + 1, decide (st.stage = j), false⟩
      else pure ⟨S', st.stage, st.hits + 1, st.used + 1, false, false⟩
    | _ => pure ⟨S', st.stage, st.hits, st.used + 1, false, false⟩

/-- **S9a**: from `S0`, for `a = 1..j`, `τ` trace steps of `P_{a, w^(a)}`, at most
`B_ret` transitions in all.  `j = 0` returns `S0`. -/

queries.subject: dyadicDraw
queries.text:
dyadicDraw noncomputable def dyadicDraw (M : ℕ) (ζ : ℚ) : PMF ℕ *`lem:dyadic-integer-draw`** (`evaluation.tex:356-371`): `k` is the least natural with `M·2^{-k} ≤ ζ`, i.e. `⌈log₂ ⌈M/ζ⌉⌉`; draw `Y` uniform on `[0, 2^k)` and return `⌊M·Y/2^k⌋`. noncomputable def dyadicDraw (M : ℕ) (ζ : ℚ) : PMF ℕ :=
  (uniformBits (Nat.clog 2 ⌈(M : ℚ) / ζ⌉₊)).map fun Y =>
    M * Y / 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 ⌈(M : ℚ) / ζ⌉₊

/-- The exact dyadic trial of probability `2^{-k}`: `k` fair bits, all `0`. -/

queries.subject: elimOrder
queries.text:
elimOrder noncomputable def elimOrder (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) The leaf-elimination order: every nonroot vertex with its parent tree edge, in reverse breadth-first order from the roots, so children come before their parents. noncomputable def elimOrder (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  let T := (forest I ε δ).tree
  ((List.range (I.m + I.n)).foldl (fun st k =>
    match st.2.1[k]? with
    | none => st
    | some u => (List.range T.length).foldl (fun st' t =>
        let e := T.getD t (0, 0, 0)
        if e.1 = u then visit (I.m + e.2.1) t st'
        else if I.m + e.2.1 = u then visit e.1 t st' else st') st)
    ((roots I ε δ).toFinset, roots I ε δ, [])).2.2

/-- `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. -/

queries.subject: baseLoad
queries.text:
baseLoad noncomputable def baseLoad (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) (v : ℕ) : ℚ The load of vertex `v` from the non-tree cells: a small cell adds `x_s` to its row and `b_s - y_s` to its column (R1); a free cell adds `z_e` to both endpoints. noncomputable def baseLoad (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) (v : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (nSmall I ε δ),
      ((if (smallAt I ε δ k).1 = v then (x k : ℚ) else 0) +
        (if I.m + (smallAt I ε δ k).2.1 = v then (((smallAt I ε δ k).2.2 - y k : ℕ) : ℚ)
          else 0))) +
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (nFree I ε δ),
      ((if (freeAt I ε δ k).1 = v then z k else 0) +
        (if I.m + (freeAt I ε δ k).2.1 = v then z k else 0))

/-- Leaf elimination: along `elimOrder`, the tree value of a nonroot vertex's
parent edge is its margin minus its current load, which is then added to the
parent.  Returns the final loads and the tree values `z_t`. -/

queries.subject: feasible
queries.text:
feasible def feasible (I : Instance) : Prop *S1** (`scales.tex:8-24`): the answer of the flow test. An integral flow of value `Σ r = Σ c` is exactly a feasible table, so the test answers `Ω(r, c, b) ≠ ∅`. def feasible (I : Instance) : Prop := I.Omega.Nonempty

noncomputable instance (I : Instance) : Decidable (feasible I) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable I.Omega.Nonempty)

/-! ## S2: tightening -/

/-- `l_ij`, the least value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω` (`0` if `Ω = ∅`, a case the
algorithm never reaches). -/

queries.subject: estimate
queries.text:
estimate noncomputable def estimate (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (c : Coins ℕ) : ℚ *The answer of one execution**: the estimate `Ẑ` that `fpras I ε δ` returns when it reads its fair bits from the coin family `c`. Specification-only. noncomputable def estimate (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (c : Coins ℕ) : ℚ :=
  (Program.fpras I ε δ c).val

/-- `estimate` is the value of the program on that coin family. -/

queries.subject: unrank
queries.text:
unrank noncomputable def unrank (b k r : ℕ) : Finset ℕ Lexicographic unranking: the `r`-th `k`-subset of `[0, b)`, built greedily (include `t` iff `r < C(b - t - 1, k' - 1)` for the `k'` still to choose). noncomputable def unrank (b k r : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  ((List.range b).foldl (fun st t =>
    if 0 < st.2.1 then
      if st.2.2 < Nat.choose (b - (t + 1)) (st.2.1 - 1) then (insert t st.1, st.2.1 - 1, st.2.2)
      else (st.1, st.2.1, st.2.2 - Nat.choose (b - (t + 1)) (st.2.1 - 1))
    else st) ((∅ : Finset ℕ), k, r)).1

/-- **A fresh `μ₀` draw** (`algorithm.tex:215-224`): per small cell `s`, `k_s` by a
dyadic draw from `{0..b_s}`, then a `k_s`-subset of its `b_s` pairs by a dyadic
draw of a rank in `[0, C(b_s, k_s))`; those pairs use their row element, the rest
their column element. -/

queries.subject: w0
queries.text:
w0 noncomputable def w0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ The initial multipliers `w^(0)` for `i ≠ l`: `6` if `s(i) = s(l)`, else `6 (b_{s(i)} + 1) / (b_{s(l)} + 2)`; `0` on the diagonal and outside `p × p`. noncomputable def w0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ := fun i l =>
  if i < pSmall I ε δ ∧ l < pSmall I ε δ ∧ i ≠ l then
    if pairCell I ε δ i = pairCell I ε δ l then 6
    else 6 * ((smallB I ε δ (pairCell I ε δ i) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) /
      ((smallB I ε δ (pairCell I ε δ l) + 2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
  else 0

/-- `C(0) = M_f ∏_{s small} (b_s + 1)`. -/

queries.subject: retained
queries.text:
retained noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry The retained cells `(i, j, u_ij - l_ij)` with positive bound, in row-major order. Cells with `b_s = 0` are deleted; all vertices are retained. noncomputable def retained (I : Instance) : List Entry :=
  (List.finRange I.m).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange I.n).filterMap fun j =>
    if 0 < cellRange I i j then some (i.val, j.val, cellRange I i j) else none

/-- Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. -/

queries.subject: kruskalStep
queries.text:
kruskalStep noncomputable def kruskalStep (m : ℕ) (F : Forest) (e : Entry) : Forest One Kruskal step (`scales.tex:91-99`): a cell joining two current components enters the tree and the components merge; otherwise it is free. noncomputable def kruskalStep (m : ℕ) (F : Forest) (e : Entry) : Forest :=
  if F.comp e.1 = F.comp (m + e.2.1) then
    { F with free := F.free ++ [e] }
  else
    { F with
      tree := F.tree ++ [e]
      comp := fun w => if F.comp w = F.comp (m + e.2.1) then F.comp e.1 else F.comp w }

/-- **S4**: the maximum-capacity spanning forest of the large-cell graph. -/

queries.subject: pow2Approx
queries.text:
pow2Approx noncomputable def pow2Approx (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) (β : ℚ) : ℚ `2^β`, approximately (R3): round `β` to the grid `h/s'`, then bisect `[0, 8]` to depth `⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉`, comparing `mid^{s'}` with `2^h`. noncomputable def pow2Approx (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) (β : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ((fun st : ℚ × ℚ =>
      if ((st.1 + st.2) / 2) ^ (2 ^ oKs I ε δ ξin) ≤
          (2 : ℚ) ^ ⌊β * 2 ^ oKs I ε δ ξin + 1 / 2⌋
        then ((st.1 + st.2) / 2, st.2) else (st.1, (st.1 + st.2) / 2))^[oDepth I ε δ ξin]
    (0, 8)).1

/-- Offsets uniform (to tolerance `ζ`) in the bin intervals
`I_{v_e} = [⌈(b_e+1) v_e/B⌉, ⌈(b_e+1)(v_e+1)/B⌉)` (R2): the integer point `z` and
`∏_e |I_{v_e}|`. -/

queries.subject: flipsRead
queries.text:
flipsRead noncomputable def flipsRead (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : Finset ℕ) : ℕ *The fair bits one execution reads**: the `Op.rand .flip` count of `fpras I ε δ` on the tape whose heads are `s`. Specification-only. noncomputable def flipsRead (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : Finset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (Program.fpras I ε δ (Coins.ofFinset s)).cost (Op.rand RandOp.flip)

/-- `tapeLength` is the supremum of the bits read over all tapes. -/

queries.subject: sortedLarge
queries.text:
sortedLarge noncomputable def sortedLarge (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry Large cells by decreasing bound, ties in retained order: each cell is inserted before the first one of strictly smaller bound. noncomputable def sortedLarge (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (largeCells I ε δ).foldl
    (fun acc x => acc.orderedInsert (fun a b : Entry => b.2.2 < a.2.2) x) []

/-- Kruskal's state: tree cells, free cells, and a component label per vertex
(rows `0..m-1`, columns `m..m+n-1`). -/

queries.subject: run
queries.text:
run noncomputable def run (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    PMF (Charged Model.Operations.Op Model.Operations.Cell ℚ) *The algorithm as a randomised charged computation**: `fpras I ε δ` run on a tape of `tapeLength I ε δ` independent fair bits. noncomputable def run (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    PMF (Charged Model.Operations.Op Model.Operations.Cell ℚ) :=
  (tape (tapeLength I ε δ)).map (Program.fpras I ε δ)

/-- **The output distribution**: the law of the estimate `Ẑ`. -/

queries.subject: Forest
queries.text:
Forest structure Forest where /-- Tree cells `T`, in insertion order. -/ Kruskal's state: tree cells, free cells, and a component label per vertex (rows `0..m-1`, columns `m..m+n-1`). structure Forest where
  /-- Tree cells `T`, in insertion order. -/
  tree : List Entry
  /-- Free cells `F`, in insertion order. -/
  free : List Entry
  /-- Component label of each vertex. -/
  comp : ℕ → ℕ

/-- One Kruskal step (`scales.tex:91-99`): a cell joining two current components
enters the tree and the components merge; otherwise it is free. -/

queries.subject: bitLen
queries.text:
bitLen def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ Binary length of a natural number in the fixed encoding: its bit size plus one, so that `0` costs one bit. def bitLen (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.size k + 1

/-- Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its
numerator and of its denominator. -/

queries.subject: cellLow
queries.text:
cellLow noncomputable def cellLow (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ `l_ij`, the least value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω` (`0` if `Ω = ∅`, a case the algorithm never reaches). noncomputable def cellLow (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  if h : I.Omega.Nonempty then (I.Omega.image fun X => X i j).min' (h.image _) else 0

/-- `u_ij`, the greatest value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω`. -/

queries.subject: ratLen
queries.text:
ratLen def ratLen (q : ℚ) : ℕ Binary length of a rational: the lengths of the absolute value of its numerator and of its denominator. def ratLen (q : ℚ) : ℕ := bitLen q.num.natAbs + bitLen q.den

/-- **The input length `L`** of `(m, n, r, c, b, ε, δ)`: the sum of the binary
lengths of `m`, `n`, every margin, every cell bound (including zero bounds),
and the two accuracy parameters. -/

queries.subject: RunState
queries.text:
RunState structure RunState where /-- `w^(a)`, for the stages stored so far. -/ The annealing run in progress: stored multipliers `w^(0..j)`, `∏ R̂`, and whether some phase aborted. structure RunState where
  /-- `w^(a)`, for the stages stored so far. -/
  ws : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ
  /-- `∏ R̂_j` so far. -/
  prod : ℚ
  /-- Some phase aborted. -/
  aborted : Bool

/-- **Phase `j`** (`algorithm.tex:214-249`): fresh `μ₀`, capped restart, `N_av`
observations; after the zero-count test, `R̂_j = û / p̂_0` and, if `j + 1 < H`,
`w^(j+1)`.  An aborted run does nothing further. -/

queries.subject: tape
queries.text:
tape noncomputable def tape (T : ℕ) : PMF (Coins ℕ) `T` independent fair bits at positions `0..T-1` (tails beyond), as the program's sealed coin family. noncomputable def tape (T : ℕ) : PMF (Coins ℕ) :=
  (tapeHeads T).map Coins.ofFinset

/-- **The tape length**: the most fair bits any execution of the algorithm on
`(I, ε, δ)` reads. -/

queries.subject: Cell
queries.text:
Cell abbrev Cell The storage currency. No space claim is made, so Arlib's standard kinds are used unchanged. abbrev Cell := Arlib.Computation.Cell

/-- **The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one
step. -/

queries.subject: tapeLength
queries.text:
tapeLength noncomputable def tapeLength (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ *The tape length**: the most fair bits any execution of the algorithm on `(I, ε, δ)` reads. noncomputable def tapeLength (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  sSup (Set.range fun s : Finset ℕ =>
    (Program.fpras I ε δ (Coins.ofFinset s)).cost (Model.Operations.Op.rand RandOp.flip))

/-- **The algorithm as a randomised charged computation**: `fpras I ε δ` run on a
tape of `tapeLength I ε δ` independent fair bits. -/

queries.subject: tapeHeads
queries.text:
tapeHeads noncomputable def tapeHeads : ℕ → PMF (Finset ℕ) | 0 => PMF.pure ∅ The positions among `0..T-1` whose fair bit came up heads, for `T` independent fair bits. noncomputable def tapeHeads : ℕ → PMF (Finset ℕ)
  | 0 => PMF.pure ∅
  | T + 1 => (tapeHeads T).bind fun s =>
      ProbRAM.fair.bind fun b => PMF.pure (if b then insert T s else s)

/-- `T` independent fair bits at positions `0..T-1` (tails beyond), as the
program's sealed coin family. -/

queries.subject: oKs
queries.text:
oKs noncomputable def oKs (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) : ℕ `log₂ s'`, where `s' = 2^{⌈log₂ ⌈32/σ⌉⌉}` is the power of two in `[32/σ, 64/σ]`. noncomputable def oKs (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.clog 2 ⌈32 / oSigma I ε δ ξin⌉₊

/-- The bisection depth `⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉`. -/

queries.subject: penalty
queries.text:
penalty noncomputable def penalty (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ *`D(x, y, z)`** `= A (Σ_roots |δ_v| + Σ_{t ∈ T} dist(z_t, [0, b_t]) / b_t)`. noncomputable def penalty (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (x y : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (AParam I ε δ : ℚ) *
    (((roots I ε δ).map fun v => |(treeValues I ε δ x y z).1 v - margin I v|).sum +
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (forest I ε δ).tree.length,
        boxDist ((treeValues I ε δ x y z).2 t) ((treeAt I ε δ t).2.2 : ℚ) /
          ((treeAt I ε δ t).2.2 : ℚ))

/-! ## S6: the weight oracle (`prop:weight-oracle`, `evaluation.tex:40-482`) -/

/-- `σ = ξ_in / (50 (H + 1))`. -/

queries.subject: rate
queries.text:
rate abbrev rate : Rate Op *The rate the theorem uses**: every operation of the currency is one step. abbrev rate : Rate Op := Rate.unit Op

/-- INTERNAL: charge `k` bit operations and return `a`.  Private, so it is not a
primitive a program can call; every public wrapper below fixes its own `k`. -/
private def bits {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell α :=
  Charged.opMany Op.bit k a

/-! ## Sealed naturals -/

/-- **A sealed natural number.**  Built only by the charged primitives of this
file, read only through them. -/

queries.subject: orderStat
queries.text:
orderStat noncomputable def orderStat (l : List ℚ) (k : ℕ) : ℚ The order statistic at position `k` (from `0`) of the multiset of outputs. noncomputable def orderStat (l : List ℚ) (k : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  ((l : Multiset ℚ).sort).getD k 0

/-- **The paper's algorithm** (`thm:main`, proof at `algorithm.tex:607-707`): the
law of `Ẑ`.  Infeasible inputs give `0` with no draw.  Otherwise
`s = ⌈log₂ δ⁻¹⌉`, `R = 10 s + 1` independent single runs (`p = 0`: `zeroRun`;
`p ≥ 1`: `annealRun`) and their median, the order statistic at `5 s`. -/

queries.subject: pairCells
queries.text:
pairCells noncomputable def pairCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ The small cell of each pair label: cell `s` owns `b_s` consecutive labels. noncomputable def pairCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (nSmall I ε δ)).flatMap fun s => List.replicate (smallB I ε δ s) s

/-- `s(i)`, the small cell of pair `i`. -/

queries.subject: Op
queries.text:
Op inductive Op where /-- One bit operation. -/ *The currency.** One bit operation, or one standard randomness operation. inductive Op where
  /-- One bit operation. -/
  | bit
  /-- One randomness operation; the program performs only `RandOp.flip`. -/
  | rand (o : RandOp)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Every operation, as a list. -/

queries.subject: Prior
queries.text:
Prior structure Prior : Prop where Every result this development takes from prior work rather than proving. structure Prior : Prop where

end Cellcounting

queries.subject: size
queries.text:
size def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat The bit size `Nat.size x`, so that `Nat.clog 2 x = Nat.size (x - 1)`. def size (x : SNat) : Charged Op Cell SNat :=
  bits (Cellcounting.bitLen x.raw) ⟨Nat.size x.raw⟩

/-- `2 ^ x`, at the price of the length of the result. -/

queries.subject: forest
queries.text:
forest noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest *S4**: the maximum-capacity spanning forest of the large-cell graph. noncomputable def forest (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : Forest :=
  (sortedLarge I ε δ).foldl (kruskalStep I.m) ⟨[], [], id⟩

/-- One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. -/

queries.subject: KParam
queries.text:
KParam noncomputable def KParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. noncomputable def KParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  20 * (inputLength I ε δ + dParam I + Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊ + 1)

/-- `γ = ε / (512 d K)`. -/

queries.subject: uniformBits
queries.text:
uniformBits noncomputable def uniformBits (k : ℕ) : PMF ℕ `k` fair bits read as a binary integer: uniform on `[0, 2^k)`. noncomputable def uniformBits (k : ℕ) : PMF ℕ :=
  PMF.uniformOfFinset (Finset.range (2 ^ k)) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.two_pow_pos k)⟩

/-- **`lem:dyadic-integer-draw`** (`evaluation.tex:356-371`): `k` is the least
natural with `M·2^{-k} ≤ ζ`, i.e. `⌈log₂ ⌈M/ζ⌉⌉`; draw `Y` uniform on `[0, 2^k)`
and return `⌊M·Y/2^k⌋`. -/

queries.subject: lit
queries.text:
lit def lit (q : ℚ) : Charged Op Cell SRat A constant or an input rational, at the price of its length. def lit (q : ℚ) : Charged Op Cell SRat := bits (ratLen q) ⟨q⟩

/-- Addition. -/

queries.subject: output
queries.text:
output noncomputable def output (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF ℚ *The output distribution**: the law of the estimate `Ẑ`. noncomputable def output (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : PMF ℚ :=
  (run I ε δ).map Charged.val

end Cellcounting

#modelClosure Cellcounting.tape
#modelClosure Cellcounting.tapeLength
#modelClosure Cellcounting.run
#modelClosure Cellcounting.output

queries.subject: cellHigh
queries.text:
cellHigh noncomputable def cellHigh (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ `u_ij`, the greatest value of cell `(i, j)` over `Ω`. noncomputable def cellHigh (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  if h : I.Omega.Nonempty then (I.Omega.image fun X => X i j).max' (h.image _) else 0

/-- The tightened bound `b_s = u_s - l_s`. -/

queries.subject: push
queries.text:
push def push {α : Type} (l : List α) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell (List α) Append one entry, at the price of walking the list. def push {α : Type} (l : List α) (a : α) : Charged Op Cell (List α) :=
  bits (l.length + 1) (l ++ [a])

/-- Allocate a list of `k` copies of `a`. -/

queries.subject: dParam
queries.text:
dParam noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. noncomputable def dParam (I : Instance) : ℕ := I.m * I.n + I.m + I.n + 2

/-- `K = 20 (L + d + ⌈log₂ ε⁻¹⌉ + 1)`, with `L = inputLength I ε δ`. -/

queries.subject: kAccParam
queries.text:
kAccParam noncomputable def kAccParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`, the bits of one acceptance threshold. noncomputable def kAccParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.clog 2 ⌈(ξParam I ε δ)⁻¹⌉₊

/-- The initial multipliers `w^(0)` for `i ≠ l`: `6` if `s(i) = s(l)`, else
`6 (b_{s(i)} + 1) / (b_{s(l)} + 2)`; `0` on the diagonal and outside `p × p`. -/

queries.subject: repeatRuns
queries.text:
repeatRuns noncomputable def repeatRuns (R : ℕ) (μ : PMF ℚ) : PMF (List ℚ) `R` independent runs of `μ`, outputs in run order. noncomputable def repeatRuns (R : ℕ) (μ : PMF ℚ) : PMF (List ℚ) :=
  loop (fun _ l => μ.map fun z => l ++ [z]) R []

/-- The order statistic at position `k` (from `0`) of the multiset of outputs. -/

queries.subject: roots
queries.text:
roots noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ One root per component: its least-indexed vertex. noncomputable def roots (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range (I.m + I.n)).filter fun v =>
    decide (∀ u < v, (forest I ε δ).comp u ≠ (forest I ε δ).comp v)

/-- Breadth-first discovery of `w` through tree edge `t`: visited set, queue,
and the discovered `(vertex, parent edge)` pairs, newest first. -/

queries.subject: JstarParam
queries.text:
JstarParam noncomputable def JstarParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `J_* = 100 (H + 1)(B_ret + N_av + p + d + 1)`. noncomputable def JstarParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  100 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) *
    (BretParam I ε δ + NavParam I ε δ + pSmall I ε δ + dParam I + 1)

/-- `ξ = η / (1000 J_*)`. -/

queries.subject: largeCells
queries.text:
largeCells noncomputable def largeCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. noncomputable def largeCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => ¬ e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- `p = Σ_{s small} b_s`. -/

queries.subject: smallCells
queries.text:
smallCells noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. noncomputable def smallCells (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Entry :=
  (retained I).filter fun e => e.2.2 < WParam I ε δ

/-- Large cells, `b_s ≥ W`, in retained order. -/

queries.subject: tCol
queries.text:
tCol noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. noncomputable def tCol (I : Instance) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : j < I.n then I.c ⟨j, h⟩ - ∑ i, cellLow I i ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

/-! ## S3: the global parameters (`eq:parameters`, `scales.tex:48-56`) -/

/-- `d = mn + m + n + 2`, with the original dimensions. -/

queries.subject: get
queries.text:
get noncomputable def get (x : SNat) : ℕ The number held. **Specification-only.** noncomputable def get (x : SNat) : ℕ := x.raw

/-- A constant or an input number, at the price of its length. -/

queries.subject: get
queries.text:
get noncomputable def get (x : SRat) : ℚ The number held. **Specification-only.** noncomputable def get (x : SRat) : ℚ := x.raw

/-- A constant or an input rational, at the price of its length. -/

queries.subject: cellFirst
queries.text:
cellFirst noncomputable def cellFirst (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ The first pair label of small cell `s`. noncomputable def cellFirst (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range s, smallB I ε δ t

/-- `q = W²`. -/

queries.subject: cellRange
queries.text:
cellRange noncomputable def cellRange (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ The tightened bound `b_s = u_s - l_s`. noncomputable def cellRange (I : Instance) (i : Fin I.m) (j : Fin I.n) : ℕ :=
  cellHigh I i j - cellLow I i j

/-- A cell of the tightened table: row, column, bound. -/

queries.subject: tRow
queries.text:
tRow noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ Tightened row margin `r_i - Σ_j l_ij`. noncomputable def tRow (I : Instance) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : i < I.m then I.r ⟨i, h⟩ - ∑ j, cellLow I ⟨i, h⟩ j else 0

/-- Tightened column margin `c_j - Σ_i l_ij`. -/

queries.subject: NavParam
queries.text:
NavParam noncomputable def NavParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `N_av = ⌈10⁸ p⁸ K_obs (H + 1) / η²⌉`. noncomputable def NavParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈((100000000 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 8 * KobsParam I ε δ * (HParam I ε δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) /
    ηParam I ε δ ^ 2⌉₊

/-- `J_* = 100 (H + 1)(B_ret + N_av + p + d + 1)`. -/

queries.subject: oDepth
queries.text:
oDepth noncomputable def oDepth (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) : ℕ The bisection depth `⌈log₂ (512/σ)⌉`. noncomputable def oDepth (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.clog 2 ⌈512 / oSigma I ε δ ξin⌉₊

/-- `⌊a D / H⌋`: `V_a = 2^{-⌊a D/H⌋}`. -/

queries.subject: idxEq
queries.text:
idxEq def idxEq (i j : ℕ) : Charged Op Cell Bool Compare two positions for equality. def idxEq (i j : ℕ) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen i + bitLen j) (decide (i = j))

/-- Compare two positions. -/

queries.subject: C0
queries.text:
C0 noncomputable def C0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ `C(0) = M_f ∏_{s small} (b_s + 1)`. noncomputable def C0 (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ((Mf I ε δ * ∏ s ∈ Finset.range (nSmall I ε δ), (smallB I ε δ s + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-! ## The paired state space (`signatures.tex:13-41`) -/

/-- The small-count profile `(x_s, y_s)` of a state `S ⊆ [0, 2p)`: row and column
elements present in small cell `s`. -/

queries.subject: pairCell
queries.text:
pairCell noncomputable def pairCell (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (i : ℕ) : ℕ `s(i)`, the small cell of pair `i`. noncomputable def pairCell (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (i : ℕ) : ℕ := (pairCells I ε δ).getD i 0

/-- The first pair label of small cell `s`. -/

queries.subject: KobsParam
queries.text:
KobsParam noncomputable def KobsParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `K_obs = 10 p⁴ (9 C_p + 2 C_d)`. noncomputable def KobsParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  10 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 4 * (9 * CpParam I ε δ + 2 * CdParam I ε δ)

/-- `η = ε / (200 (H + 1))`. -/

queries.subject: smallB
queries.text:
smallB noncomputable def smallB (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ `b_s` of the `s`-th small cell. noncomputable def smallB (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (s : ℕ) : ℕ := (smallAt I ε δ s).2.2

/-- The small cell of each pair label: cell `s` owns `b_s` consecutive labels. -/

queries.subject: τParam
queries.text:
τParam noncomputable def τParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `τ = 2 K_obs (H + p + K + 5)`. noncomputable def τParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  2 * KobsParam I ε δ * (HParam I ε δ + pSmall I ε δ + KParam I ε δ + 5)

/-- `B_ret = 2000 p² (H + 1)² τ`. -/

queries.subject: BretParam
queries.text:
BretParam noncomputable def BretParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `B_ret = 2000 p² (H + 1)² τ`. noncomputable def BretParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  2000 * pSmall I ε δ ^ 2 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) ^ 2 * τParam I ε δ

/-- `N_av = ⌈10⁸ p⁸ K_obs (H + 1) / η²⌉`. -/

queries.subject: SRat
queries.text:
SRat structure SRat where private mk :: *A sealed rational number.** structure SRat where
  private mk ::
  private raw : ℚ

namespace SNat

/-- The number held.  **Specification-only.** -/

queries.subject: Mf
queries.text:
Mf noncomputable def Mf (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `M_f = ∏_{e ∈ F} (b_e + 1)`. noncomputable def Mf (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((forest I ε δ).free.map fun e => e.2.2 + 1).prod

/-! ## S5: the penalty `D(x, y, z)` (`eq:penalty`, `scales.tex:113-126`) -/

/-- Number of small cells. -/

queries.subject: all
queries.text:
all def Op.all : List Op Every operation, as a list. def Op.all : List Op :=
  [.bit, .rand .flip, .rand .accept, .rand .halve, .rand .inflate]

/-- The currency is finite, so `CostVec.steps` can sum over it. -/
instance : Fintype Op :=
  Fintype.ofList Op.all (by intro o; cases o with
    | bit => decide
    | rand r => cases r <;> decide)

/-- The randomness operations, filed under `Op.rand`. -/

queries.subject: nFree
queries.text:
nFree noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ Number of free cells, `e`. noncomputable def nFree (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (forest I ε δ).free.length

/-- The `k`-th small cell. -/

queries.subject: oSigma
queries.text:
oSigma noncomputable def oSigma (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) : ℚ `σ = ξ_in / (50 (H + 1))`. noncomputable def oSigma (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (ξin : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ξin / (50 * ((HParam I ε δ : ℚ) + 1))

/-- `N_in = ⌈10⁶ (H + 1) / (θ σ²)⌉`. -/

queries.subject: ηParam
queries.text:
ηParam noncomputable def ηParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ `η = ε / (200 (H + 1))`. noncomputable def ηParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ε / ((200 * (HParam I ε δ + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-- `τ = 2 K_obs (H + p + K + 5)`. -/

queries.subject: CpParam
queries.text:
CpParam noncomputable def CpParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `C_p = p (1 + 8 p q²)`. noncomputable def CpParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  pSmall I ε δ * (1 + 8 * pSmall I ε δ * qParam I ε δ ^ 2)

/-- `C_d = 8 + 32 p q³`. -/

queries.subject: idxLt
queries.text:
idxLt def idxLt (i j : ℕ) : Charged Op Cell Bool Compare two positions. def idxLt (i j : ℕ) : Charged Op Cell Bool :=
  bits (bitLen i + bitLen j) (decide (i < j))

end Operations

queries.subject: HParam
queries.text:
HParam noncomputable def HParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. noncomputable def HParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  10 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2 * (WParam I ε δ + 1)

/-! ## S4: small and large cells, the maximum spanning forest -/

/-- Small cells, `b_s < W`, in retained order. -/

queries.subject: nSmall
queries.text:
nSmall noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ Number of small cells. noncomputable def nSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := (smallCells I ε δ).length

/-- Number of free cells, `e`. -/

queries.subject: pSmall
queries.text:
pSmall noncomputable def pSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `p = Σ_{s small} b_s`. noncomputable def pSmall (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((smallCells I ε δ).map fun e => e.2.2).sum

/-- Large cells by decreasing bound, ties in retained order: each cell is
inserted before the first one of strictly smaller bound. -/

queries.subject: smallAt
queries.text:
smallAt noncomputable def smallAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry The `k`-th small cell. noncomputable def smallAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry :=
  (smallCells I ε δ).getD k (0, 0, 0)

/-- The `k`-th free cell. -/

queries.subject: freeAt
queries.text:
freeAt noncomputable def freeAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry The `k`-th free cell. noncomputable def freeAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (k : ℕ) : Entry :=
  (forest I ε δ).free.getD k (0, 0, 0)

/-- The `t`-th tree cell. -/

queries.subject: treeAt
queries.text:
treeAt noncomputable def treeAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (t : ℕ) : Entry The `t`-th tree cell. noncomputable def treeAt (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) (t : ℕ) : Entry :=
  (forest I ε δ).tree.getD t (0, 0, 0)

/-- The prescribed (tightened) margin of vertex `v`. -/

queries.subject: ξParam
queries.text:
ξParam noncomputable def ξParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ `ξ = η / (1000 J_*)`. noncomputable def ξParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ηParam I ε δ / ((1000 * JstarParam I ε δ : ℕ) : ℚ)

/-- `⌈log₂ ξ⁻¹⌉`, the bits of one acceptance threshold. -/

queries.subject: CdParam
queries.text:
CdParam noncomputable def CdParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `C_d = 8 + 32 p q³`. noncomputable def CdParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  8 + 32 * pSmall I ε δ * qParam I ε δ ^ 3

/-- `K_obs = 10 p⁴ (9 C_p + 2 C_d)`. -/

queries.subject: γParam
queries.text:
γParam noncomputable def γParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ `γ = ε / (512 d K)`. noncomputable def γParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ε / (512 * dParam I * KParam I ε δ)

/-- `A = ⌈4K/γ⌉`. -/

queries.subject: boxDist
queries.text:
boxDist noncomputable def boxDist (x b : ℚ) : ℚ `dist(x, [0, b])`. noncomputable def boxDist (x b : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  if x < 0 then -x else if b < x then x - b else 0

/-- **`D(x, y, z)`** `= A (Σ_roots |δ_v| + Σ_{t ∈ T} dist(z_t, [0, b_t]) / b_t)`. -/

queries.subject: sRep
queries.text:
sRep noncomputable def sRep (δ : ℚ) : ℕ `s = ⌈log₂ δ⁻¹⌉`. noncomputable def sRep (δ : ℚ) : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈δ⁻¹⌉₊

/-- `R` independent runs of `μ`, outputs in run order. -/

queries.subject: BParam
queries.text:
BParam noncomputable def BParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `B = 16 A d²`. noncomputable def BParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 16 * AParam I ε δ * dParam I ^ 2

/-- `W = 100 d B`. -/

queries.subject: WParam
queries.text:
WParam noncomputable def WParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `W = 100 d B`. noncomputable def WParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := 100 * dParam I * BParam I ε δ

/-- `H = 10 A d² (W + 1)`. -/

queries.subject: AParam
queries.text:
AParam noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `A = ⌈4K/γ⌉`. noncomputable def AParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈(4 * KParam I ε δ : ℚ) / γParam I ε δ⌉₊

/-- `B = 16 A d²`. -/

queries.subject: qParam
queries.text:
qParam noncomputable def qParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ `q = W²`. noncomputable def qParam (I : Instance) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ := WParam I ε δ ^ 2

/-- `C_p = p (1 + 8 p q²)`. -/
